```rust
#[cfg_attr(feature = "openapi", derive(utoipa::ToSchema))]
#[serde(rename_all = "kebab-case")]
pub enum VmPhase {
    #[default]
    Stopped,
    Starting,
    Running,
    Stopping,
    Failed,
    /// 다른 노드로 라이브 마이그레이션 중이다(원본 QEMU가 아직 돈다).
    Migrating,
}

/// `52:54:00:12:34:56` 형식의 MAC 주소.
#[derive(Debug, Clone, Copy, PartialEq, Eq, PartialOrd, Ord, Hash, Serialize, Deserialize)]
#[cfg_attr(feature = "openapi", derive(utoipa::ToSchema), schema(value_type = String))]
#[serde(try_from = "String", into = "String")]
pub struct MacAddr(pub [u8; 6]);

impl MacAddr {
    /// QEMU/KVM 관례 접두사 `52:54:00`에 난수 3바이트를 붙인 주소를 만든다.
    /// 난수가 24비트라 VM이 많으면 충돌할 수 있다. 호출자(API)는 클러스터 안에서 중복을 확인하고 다시 뽑는다.
    pub fn generate() -> Self {
        let r = Uuid::new_v4().into_bytes();
        MacAddr([0x52, 0x54, 0x00, r[0], r[1], r[2]])
    }
}

#[derive(Debug, Error, PartialEq, Eq)]
#[error("invalid MAC address: {0}")]
pub struct MacParseError(String);

impl FromStr for MacAddr {
    type Err = MacParseError;

    fn from_str(s: &str) -> Result<Self, Self::Err> {
        let err = || MacParseError(s.to_string());
        let mut bytes = [0u8; 6];
        let mut parts = s.split(':');
        for b in &mut bytes {
            let part = parts.next().ok_or_else(err)?;
            if part.len() != 2 || !part.bytes().all(|c| c.is_ascii_hexdigit()) {
                return Err(err());
            }
            *b = u8::from_str_radix(part, 16).map_err(|_| err())?;
        }
        if parts.next().is_some() {
            return Err(err());
        }
        Ok(MacAddr(bytes))
    }
}

impl fmt::Display for MacAddr {
    fn fmt(&self, f: &mut fmt::Formatter<'_>) -> fmt::Result {
        let b = self.0;
        write!(
            f,
            "{:02x}:{:02x}:{:02x}:{:02x}:{:02x}:{:02x}",
            b[0], b[1], b[2], b[3], b[4], b[5]
        )
    }
}

impl TryFrom<String> for MacAddr {
    type Error = MacParseError;

    fn try_from(s: String) -> Result<Self, Self::Error> {
        s.parse()
    }
}

impl From<MacAddr> for String {
    fn from(m: MacAddr) -> String {
        m.to_string()
    }
}

#[cfg(test)]
mod tests {
    use super::*;

    fn sample_json() -> serde_json::Value {
        serde_json::json!({
            "cpu": { "cores": 4 },
            "memory_mib": 8192,
            "machine": "q35",
            "disks": [ { "volume": "web-01-root", "bus": "virtio-blk", "boot_order": 1 } ],
            "nics": [ { "network": "lan", "model": "virtio" } ],
            "power": "running",
            "restart": "on-failure"
        })
    }

    fn sample() -> VmSpec {
        serde_json::from_value(sample_json()).unwrap()
    }

    #[test]
    fn arch_serializes_as_lowercase_and_pairs_with_machine() {
        assert_eq!(serde_json::to_value(Arch::X86_64).unwrap(), "x86_64");
        assert_eq!(serde_json::to_value(Arch::Aarch64).unwrap(), "aarch64");
        assert_eq!(
            serde_json::from_value::<Arch>(serde_json::json!("aarch64")).unwrap(),
            Arch::Aarch64
        );
        for arch in [Arch::X86_64, Arch::Aarch64] {
            assert_eq!(arch.machine().arch(), arch);
        }
        assert_eq!(MachineType::Q35.arch(), Arch::X86_64);
        assert_eq!(MachineType::Virt.arch(), Arch::Aarch64);
    }

    #[test]
    fn deserializes_with_defaults() {
        let spec = sample();
        assert_eq!(spec.cpu.sockets, 1);
        assert_eq!(spec.cpu.model, CpuModel::Host);
        assert_eq!(spec.firmware, Firmware::Uefi);
        assert_eq!(spec.disks[0].bus, DiskBus::VirtioBlk);
        assert_eq!(spec.nics[0].mac, None);
        assert_eq!(spec.power, PowerState::Running);
        assert_eq!(spec.restart, RestartPolicy::OnFailure);
        assert_eq!(spec.node, None);
        assert_eq!(spec.snapshot_schedule, None);
        assert_eq!(spec.ha, None);
    }

    #[test]
    fn rejects_unknown_fields() {
        let mut json = sample_json();
        json["memroy_mib"] = 1.into();
        assert!(serde_json::from_value::<VmSpec>(json).is_err());
    }

    #[test]
    fn round_trips_through_json() {
        let spec = sample();
        let back: VmSpec = serde_json::from_value(serde_json::to_value(&spec).unwrap()).unwrap();
        assert_eq!(back, spec);
    }

    #[test]
    fn validate_accepts_sample() {
        assert_eq!(sample().validate(), Ok(()));
    }

    #[test]
    fn validate_rejects_bad_values() {
        let mut s = sample();
        s.cpu.cores = 0;
        assert_eq!(s.validate(), Err(ValidationError::ZeroCores));

        let mut s = sample();
        s.cpu.sockets = 0;
        assert_eq!(s.validate(), Err(ValidationError::ZeroSockets));

        let mut s = sample();
        s.memory_mib = MIN_MEMORY_MIB - 1;
        assert_eq!(s.validate(), Err(ValidationError::TooLittleMemory));

        let mut s = sample();
        let mut second = s.disks[0].clone();
        second.volume = "data".into();
        s.disks.push(second);
        assert_eq!(s.validate(), Err(ValidationError::DuplicateBootOrder(1)));

        let mut s = sample();
        let mac: MacAddr = "01:00:5e:00:00:01".parse().unwrap();
        s.nics[0].mac = Some(mac);
        assert_eq!(s.validate(), Err(ValidationError::MulticastMac(mac)));

        let mut s = sample();
        let mac: MacAddr = "52:54:00:12:34:56".parse().unwrap();
        s.nics[0].mac = Some(mac);
        let mut second = s.nics[0].clone();
        second.network = "wan".into();
        s.nics.push(second);
        assert_eq!(s.validate(), Err(ValidationError::DuplicateMac(mac)));

        let mut s = sample();
        s.nics = vec![s.nics[0].clone(); MAX_NICS + 1];
        for nic in &mut s.nics {
            nic.mac = None;
        }
        assert_eq!(s.validate(), Err(ValidationError::TooManyNics));
    }

    #[test]
    fn validate_checks_nic_security_groups() {
        let with_groups = |groups: &[&str]| {
            let mut s = sample();
            let mut second = s.nics[0].clone();
            second.network = "wan".into();
            second.security_groups = groups.iter().map(|g| g.to_string()).collect();
            s.nics.push(second);
            s.validate()
        };
        assert_eq!(with_groups(&[]), Ok(()));
        let eight: Vec<String> = (0..MAX_NIC_SECURITY_GROUPS)
            .map(|i| format!("g{i}"))
            .collect();
        let eight: Vec<&str> = eight.iter().map(String::as_str).collect();
        assert_eq!(with_groups(&eight), Ok(()));
        let mut nine = eight.clone();
        nine.push("g8");
        assert_eq!(
            with_groups(&nine),
            Err(ValidationError::TooManySecurityGroups(1))
        );
        assert_eq!(
            with_groups(&["web", "ssh", "web"]),
            Err(ValidationError::DuplicateSecurityGroup(1, "web".into()))
        );
        assert_eq!(
            ValidationError::DuplicateSecurityGroup(1, "web".into()).to_string(),
            "nics[1]: security group \"web\" is listed more than once"
        );
        // 다른 NIC에 같은 그룹을 거는 것은 된다.
        let mut s = sample();
        s.nics[0].security_groups = vec!["web".into()];
        let mut second = s.nics[0].clone();
        second.network = "wan".into();
        s.nics.push(second);
        assert_eq!(s.validate(), Ok(()));
    }

        assert!(!s.has_firewall());
        let mut second = s.nics[0].clone();
        second.security_groups = vec!["web".into()];
        s.nics.push(second);
        assert!(s.has_firewall());
    }

    #[test]
    fn migration_status_is_written_only_while_migrating() {
        // 마이그레이션이 없으면 필드를 빼고 쓴다.
        let json = serde_json::to_value(VmStatus::default()).unwrap();
        assert!(json.get("migration").is_none(), "{json}");
        let st = VmStatus {
            phase: VmPhase::Migrating,
            migration: Some(MigrationStatus {
                node: Uuid::now_v7(),
                task: Uuid::now_v7(),
                disks: vec![],
            }),
            ..Default::default()
        };
        let m = st.migration.clone().unwrap();
        let json = serde_json::to_value(&st).unwrap();
        assert_eq!(json["phase"], "migrating");
        // 복사할 디스크가 없으면 disks를 빼고 쓴다(옛 모양).
        assert_eq!(
            json["migration"],
            serde_json::json!({ "node": m.node, "task": m.task })
        );
        assert_eq!(serde_json::from_value::<VmStatus>(json).unwrap(), st);
    }

    #[test]
    fn migration_status_carries_the_disk_moves() {
        let volume = Uuid::now_v7();
        let m = MigrationStatus {
            node: Uuid::now_v7(),
            task: Uuid::now_v7(),
            disks: vec![DiskMove {
                volume,
                pool: "fast".into(),
                format: ImageFormat::Raw,
            }],
        };
        let json = serde_json::to_value(&m).unwrap();
        assert_eq!(
            json,
            serde_json::json!({
                "node": m.node,
                "task": m.task,
                "disks": [{ "volume": volume, "pool": "fast", "format": "raw" }]
            })
        );
        assert_eq!(serde_json::from_value::<MigrationStatus>(json).unwrap(), m);
    }

    #[test]
    fn schedule_error_reads_old_string_and_writes_structure() {
        let e = ScheduleError {
            code: "vm_busy".into(),
            message: "VM web is busy".into(),
        };
        let json = serde_json::to_value(&e).unwrap();
        assert_eq!(
            json,
            serde_json::json!({ "code": "vm_busy", "message": "VM web is busy" })
        );
        assert_eq!(serde_json::from_value::<ScheduleError>(json).unwrap(), e);
        // 옛 상태는 문자열이었다. code를 모르므로 unknown으로 읽는다.
        let st: VmStatus =
            serde_json::from_value(serde_json::json!({ "schedule_error": "VM web is busy" }))
                .unwrap();
        assert_eq!(
            st.schedule_error,
            Some(ScheduleError {
                code: "unknown".into(),
                message: "VM web is busy".into(),
            })
        );
        assert_eq!(
            serde_json::to_value(&st).unwrap()["schedule_error"],
            serde_json::json!({ "code": "unknown", "message": "VM web is busy" })
        );
    }

    // 이 계획 전(bf40f46)에 쓴 VM의 JSON 그대로.
    const OLD_VM_JSON: &str = r#"{"cpu":{"sockets":1,"cores":4,"model":"host"},"memory_mib":8192,"firmware":"uefi","machine":"q35","disks":[{"volume":"web-01-root","bus":"virtio-blk","boot_order":1}],"nics":[{"network":"lan","model":"virtio","mac":"52:54:00:12:34:56"}],"power":"running","restart":"on-failure","node":"0193a6f2-7c4e-7d1a-9b3e-2f4c5d6e7f80","snapshot_schedule":null,"ha":false}"#;

    #[test]
    fn ha_reads_old_bools() {
        let mut json = sample_json();
        json["ha"] = false.into();
        assert_eq!(
            serde_json::from_value::<VmSpec>(json.clone()).unwrap().ha,
            None
        );
        json["ha"] = true.into();
        assert_eq!(
            serde_json::from_value::<VmSpec>(json).unwrap().ha,
            Some(VmHa::default())
        );
        // 필드가 없으면 HA가 아니다.
        assert_eq!(sample().ha, None);
    }

    #[test]
    fn old_vm_json_round_trips_byte_for_byte() {
        let spec: VmSpec = serde_json::from_str(OLD_VM_JSON).unwrap();
        assert_eq!(spec.ha, None);
        assert_eq!(serde_json::to_string(&spec).unwrap(), OLD_VM_JSON);
        let old_ha = OLD_VM_JSON.replace(r#""ha":false"#, r#""ha":true"#);
        let spec: VmSpec = serde_json::from_str(&old_ha).unwrap();
        assert_eq!(spec.ha, Some(VmHa::default()));
        assert_eq!(serde_json::to_string(&spec).unwrap(), old_ha);
    }

    /// `placement`가 없으면 옛 VM 그대로 쓰고, 있으면 왕복한다. `{}`은 고정하지 않음이고 모르는 키는 거절한다.
    #[test]
    fn placement_is_written_only_when_set() {
        let spec: VmSpec = serde_json::from_str(OLD_VM_JSON).unwrap();
        assert_eq!(spec.placement, None);
        assert!(!spec.pinned());
        assert_eq!(serde_json::to_string(&spec).unwrap(), OLD_VM_JSON);

        let mut json = sample_json();
        json["placement"] = serde_json::json!({ "pinned": true });
        let spec: VmSpec = serde_json::from_value(json.clone()).unwrap();
        assert!(spec.pinned());
        let back = serde_json::to_value(&spec).unwrap();
        assert_eq!(back["placement"], serde_json::json!({ "pinned": true }));
        assert_eq!(serde_json::from_value::<VmSpec>(back).unwrap(), spec);

        json["placement"] = serde_json::json!({});
        let spec: VmSpec = serde_json::from_value(json.clone()).unwrap();
        assert_eq!(spec.placement, Some(VmPlacement { pinned: false }));
        assert!(!spec.pinned());
        json["placement"] = serde_json::json!({ "pinned": true, "weight": 1 });
        assert!(serde_json::from_value::<VmSpec>(json).is_err());
    }

        spec.ha = Some(VmHa::default());

    #[test]
    fn ha_object_fills_missing_fields_and_rejects_unknown() {
        let mut json = sample_json();
        json["ha"] = serde_json::json!({ "group": "g" });
        assert_eq!(
            serde_json::from_value::<VmSpec>(json.clone()).unwrap().ha,
            Some(VmHa {
                group: Some("g".into()),
                ..Default::default()
            })
        );
        // 빈 객체는 기본 정책이고 다시 쓰면 true다.
        json["ha"] = serde_json::json!({});
        let spec: VmSpec = serde_json::from_value(json.clone()).unwrap();
        assert_eq!(spec.ha, Some(VmHa::default()));
        assert_eq!(serde_json::to_value(&spec).unwrap()["ha"], true);

        for bad in [
            serde_json::json!({ "state": "started", "weight": 1 }),
            serde_json::json!({ "guest_watch": { "timeout_secs": 60, "interval": 5 } }),
            serde_json::json!({ "priority": "high" }),
            serde_json::json!({ "state": "paused" }),
            serde_json::json!("yes"),
            serde_json::json!(1),
            serde_json::Value::Null,
        ] {
            json["ha"] = bad.clone();
            assert!(
                serde_json::from_value::<VmSpec>(json.clone()).is_err(),
                "{bad} should be rejected"
            );
        }
    }

    /// 계획 50 노드가 쓴 그룹 정책 객체는 바이트까지 그대로 읽고 쓴다(새 필드가 기본값이면 쓰지 않는다).
    #[test]
    fn plan50_policy_object_round_trips_byte_for_byte() {
        let old = OLD_VM_JSON.replace(
            r#""ha":false"#,
            r#""ha":{"state":"started","group":"rack-a","max_restart":1,"max_relocate":1}"#,
        );
        let spec: VmSpec = serde_json::from_str(&old).unwrap();
        let ha = spec.ha.clone().unwrap();
        assert_eq!(ha.priority, DEFAULT_HA_PRIORITY);
        assert_eq!(ha.guest_watch, None);
        assert!(!ha.uses_fast_ha());
        assert_eq!(serde_json::to_string(&spec).unwrap(), old);
    }

    /// 우선순위·게스트 감시는 기본이 아니면 객체에 나타나고 다시 읽힌다. 기본 정책은 그대로 `true`다.
    #[test]
    fn priority_and_guest_watch_are_written_only_when_set() {
        let mut spec = sample();
        spec.ha = Some(VmHa {
            priority: DEFAULT_HA_PRIORITY,
            guest_watch: None,
            ..Default::default()
        });
        assert_eq!(serde_json::to_value(&spec).unwrap()["ha"], true);

        spec.ha = Some(VmHa {
            priority: 80,
            ..Default::default()
        });
        assert!(spec.ha.as_ref().unwrap().uses_fast_ha());
        let json = serde_json::to_value(&spec).unwrap();
        assert_eq!(
            json["ha"],
            serde_json::json!({ "state": "started", "max_restart": 1, "max_relocate": 1, "priority": 80 })
        );
        assert_eq!(serde_json::from_value::<VmSpec>(json).unwrap(), spec);

        spec.ha = Some(VmHa {
            guest_watch: Some(GuestWatch { timeout_secs: 120 }),
            ..Default::default()
        });
        assert!(spec.ha.as_ref().unwrap().uses_fast_ha());
        let json = serde_json::to_value(&spec).unwrap();
        assert_eq!(
            json["ha"],
            serde_json::json!({
                "state": "started",
                "max_restart": 1,
                "max_relocate": 1,
                "guest_watch": { "timeout_secs": 120 }
            })
        );
        assert_eq!(serde_json::from_value::<VmSpec>(json).unwrap(), spec);

        // 빈 감시 객체는 기본 60초다.
        let mut json = sample_json();
        json["ha"] = serde_json::json!({ "guest_watch": {} });
        let ha = serde_json::from_value::<VmSpec>(json).unwrap().ha.unwrap();
        assert_eq!(ha.guest_watch, Some(GuestWatch { timeout_secs: 60 }));
    }

    /// 핫플러그 상한이 없으면 옛 VM 그대로 쓰고, 있으면 왕복한다. 소켓·모델을 뺀 CPU 객체도 읽는다.
    #[test]
    fn hotplug_maximums_are_written_only_when_set() {
        let spec: VmSpec = serde_json::from_str(OLD_VM_JSON).unwrap();
        assert_eq!((spec.cpu.max_vcpus, spec.max_memory_mib), (None, None));
        assert_eq!(serde_json::to_string(&spec).unwrap(), OLD_VM_JSON);

        let cpu: CpuSpec =
            serde_json::from_value(serde_json::json!({ "cores": 2, "max_vcpus": 8 })).unwrap();
        assert_eq!(
            cpu,
            CpuSpec {
                sockets: 1,
                cores: 2,
                model: CpuModel::Host,
                max_vcpus: Some(8),
            }
        );
        assert_eq!((cpu.vcpus(), cpu.max()), (2, 8));
        let mut json = sample_json();
        json["cpu"] = serde_json::json!({ "cores": 2, "max_vcpus": 8 });
        json["max_memory_mib"] = 16384.into();
        let spec: VmSpec = serde_json::from_value(json).unwrap();
        assert_eq!(spec.max_memory_mib, Some(16384));
        let back = serde_json::to_value(&spec).unwrap();
        assert_eq!(back["cpu"]["max_vcpus"], 8);
        assert_eq!(back["max_memory_mib"], 16384);
        assert_eq!(serde_json::from_value::<VmSpec>(back).unwrap(), spec);
        assert!(
            serde_json::from_value::<CpuSpec>(serde_json::json!({ "cores": 2, "max_cpus": 8 }))
                .is_err()
        );
    }

    #[test]
    fn validate_checks_hotplug_maximums() {
        let with_cpu = |sockets, cores, max| {
            let mut s = sample();
            s.cpu.sockets = sockets;
            s.cpu.cores = cores;
            s.cpu.max_vcpus = Some(max);
            s.validate()
        };
        assert_eq!(with_cpu(1, 4, 4), Ok(()));
        assert_eq!(with_cpu(2, 2, MAX_VCPUS), Ok(()));
        assert_eq!(with_cpu(2, 2, 3), Err(ValidationError::MaxVcpusBelow(4)));
        assert_eq!(with_cpu(2, 2, 6), Ok(()));
        assert_eq!(with_cpu(2, 2, 7), Err(ValidationError::MaxVcpusSockets));
        assert_eq!(
            with_cpu(1, 2, MAX_VCPUS + 1),
            Err(ValidationError::MaxVcpusTooMany)
        );
        assert_eq!(
            ValidationError::MaxVcpusBelow(4).to_string(),
            "cpu.max_vcpus must be at least cpu.sockets × cpu.cores (4)"
        );
        assert_eq!(
            ValidationError::MaxVcpusSockets.to_string(),
            "cpu.max_vcpus must be a multiple of cpu.sockets"
        );
        assert_eq!(
            ValidationError::MaxVcpusTooMany.to_string(),
            "cpu.max_vcpus must be at most 256"
        );

        let with_memory = |memory, max| {
            let mut s = sample();
            s.memory_mib = memory;
            s.max_memory_mib = Some(max);
            s.validate()
        };
        assert_eq!(with_memory(4096, 4096), Ok(()));
        assert_eq!(with_memory(4096, MAX_HOTPLUG_MEMORY_MIB), Ok(()));
        assert_eq!(
            with_memory(4096, 3968),
            Err(ValidationError::MaxMemoryBelow)
        );
        assert_eq!(
            with_memory(4096, MAX_HOTPLUG_MEMORY_MIB + 128),
            Err(ValidationError::MaxMemoryTooMuch)
        );
        assert_eq!(with_memory(4096, 8200), Err(ValidationError::MemoryAlign));
        assert_eq!(with_memory(4000, 8192), Err(ValidationError::MemoryAlign));
        assert_eq!(
            ValidationError::MaxMemoryBelow.to_string(),
            "max_memory_mib must be at least memory_mib"
        );
        assert_eq!(
            ValidationError::MaxMemoryTooMuch.to_string(),
            "max_memory_mib must be at most 524288"
        );
        assert_eq!(
            ValidationError::MemoryAlign.to_string(),
            "memory_mib and max_memory_mib must be multiples of 128 when max_memory_mib is set"
        );
        // 상한이 없으면 메모리 단위를 보지 않는다.
        let mut s = sample();
        s.memory_mib = 4000;
        assert_eq!(s.validate(), Ok(()));
    }

    /// 실행 중 하드웨어 기록이 없으면 옛 상태 그대로 쓰고, 옛 노드처럼 모르는 필드는 버리고 읽는다.
    #[test]
    fn status_hardware_is_written_only_while_running() {
        let json = serde_json::to_value(VmStatus::default()).unwrap();
        assert!(json.get("hardware").is_none(), "{json}");
        let old = serde_json::json!({
            "phase": "running", "node": null, "pid": 7, "last_error": null,
            "snapshot": null, "schedule_error": null
        });
        let st: VmStatus = serde_json::from_value(old.clone()).unwrap();
        assert_eq!(st.hardware, None);
        assert_eq!(serde_json::to_value(&st).unwrap(), old);
        let mut newer = old.clone();
        newer["future"] = serde_json::json!({ "x": 1 });
        assert_eq!(serde_json::from_value::<VmStatus>(newer).unwrap(), st);

        let st = VmStatus {
            phase: VmPhase::Running,
            hardware: Some(RunningHardware::legacy(&sample())),
            ..Default::default()
        };
        let json = serde_json::to_value(&st).unwrap();
        assert_eq!(json["hardware"]["memory_mib"], 8192);
        assert_eq!(json["hardware"]["cpu"]["cores"], 4);
        assert!(json["hardware"].get("layout").is_none(), "{json}");
        assert_eq!(serde_json::from_value::<VmStatus>(json).unwrap(), st);
    }

    #[test]
    fn validate_checks_priority_and_guest_watch() {
        let with = |priority, timeout_secs: Option<u32>| {
            let mut s = sample();
            s.ha = Some(VmHa {
                priority,
                guest_watch: timeout_secs.map(|timeout_secs| GuestWatch { timeout_secs }),
                ..Default::default()
            });
            s.validate()
        };
        assert_eq!(with(0, None), Ok(()));
        assert_eq!(with(MAX_HA_PRIORITY, Some(30)), Ok(()));
        assert_eq!(with(50, Some(3600)), Ok(()));
        assert_eq!(
            with(MAX_HA_PRIORITY + 1, None),
            Err(ValidationError::HaPriority)
        );
        assert_eq!(with(50, Some(29)), Err(ValidationError::GuestWatch));
        assert_eq!(with(50, Some(3601)), Err(ValidationError::GuestWatch));
        assert_eq!(
            ValidationError::GuestWatch.to_string(),
            "ha.guest_watch.timeout_secs must be between 30 and 3600"
        );
    }

    #[test]
    fn validate_checks_ha_counts() {
        let with = |max_restart, max_relocate| {
            let mut s = sample();
            s.ha = Some(VmHa {
                max_restart,
                max_relocate,
                ..Default::default()
            });
            s.validate()
        };
        assert_eq!(with(0, 0), Ok(()));
        assert_eq!(with(MAX_HA_COUNT, MAX_HA_COUNT), Ok(()));
        assert_eq!(with(MAX_HA_COUNT + 1, 1), Err(ValidationError::HaCount));
        assert_eq!(with(1, MAX_HA_COUNT + 1), Err(ValidationError::HaCount));
    }

    #[test]
    fn ha_active_ignores_ignored_state() {
        let mut s = sample();
        assert!(!s.ha_active());
        for (state, active) in [
            (HaState::Started, true),
            (HaState::Stopped, true),
            (HaState::Ignored, false),
        ] {
            s.ha = Some(VmHa {
                state,
                ..Default::default()
            });
            assert_eq!(s.ha_active(), active, "{state:?}");
        }
    }

    #[test]
    fn status_ha_fields_are_written_only_when_set() {
        // 비어 있으면 옛 모양 그대로다.
        let old = serde_json::json!({
            "phase": "running",
            "node": null,
            "pid": 7,
            "last_error": null,
            "snapshot": null,
            "schedule_error": null
        });
        let st: VmStatus = serde_json::from_value(old.clone()).unwrap();
        assert!(st.rule_violations.is_empty());
        assert_eq!(st.ha, None);
        assert_eq!(serde_json::to_value(&st).unwrap(), old);

        let node = Uuid::now_v7();
        let st = VmStatus {
            rule_violations: vec!["keep-apart".into()],
            ha: Some(VmHaStatus {
                relocate_from: Some(node),
                relocations: vec![100, 200],
                relocated_from: Some(node),
                error: Some("gave up after 1 relocations".into()),
                evict: None,
            }),
            ..Default::default()
        };
        let json = serde_json::to_value(&st).unwrap();
        assert_eq!(json["rule_violations"], serde_json::json!(["keep-apart"]));
        assert_eq!(
            json["ha"],
            serde_json::json!({
                "relocate_from": node,
                "relocations": [100, 200],
                "relocated_from": node,
                "error": "gave up after 1 relocations"
            })
        );
        assert_eq!(serde_json::from_value::<VmStatus>(json).unwrap(), st);
        // 빈 기록의 필드는 빼고 쓴다.
        assert_eq!(
            serde_json::to_value(VmHaStatus::default()).unwrap(),
            serde_json::json!({})
        );
        // 끄기 요청은 있을 때만 쓴다.
        let ha = VmHaStatus {
            evict: Some(HaEvict {
                from: node,
                check: "stor".into(),
                reason: "HA check stor failed".into(),
                at: 1_793_000_000,
            }),
            ..Default::default()
        };
        let json = serde_json::to_value(&ha).unwrap();
        assert_eq!(
            json,
            serde_json::json!({ "evict": {
                "from": node, "check": "stor", "reason": "HA check stor failed", "at": 1_793_000_000u64
            } })
        );
        assert_eq!(serde_json::from_value::<VmHaStatus>(json).unwrap(), ha);
    }

    #[test]
    fn snapshot_schedule_defaults_to_none() {
        assert_eq!(sample().snapshot_schedule, None);
    }

    #[test]
    fn snapshot_schedule_round_trips() {
        let mut json = sample_json();
        json["snapshot_schedule"] = serde_json::json!({ "every": "daily", "keep": 7 });
        let spec: VmSpec = serde_json::from_value(json).unwrap();
        assert_eq!(
            spec.snapshot_schedule,
            Some(SnapshotSchedule {
                every: ScheduleEvery::Daily,
                keep: 7,
                memory: false,
            })
        );
        let back = serde_json::to_value(&spec).unwrap();
        assert_eq!(
            back["snapshot_schedule"],
            serde_json::json!({ "every": "daily", "keep": 7, "memory": false })
        );
        for (every, text) in [
            (ScheduleEvery::Hourly, "hourly"),
            (ScheduleEvery::Daily, "daily"),
            (ScheduleEvery::Weekly, "weekly"),
        ] {
            assert_eq!(serde_json::to_value(every).unwrap(), text);
        }

        let mut json = sample_json();
        json["snapshot_schedule"] = serde_json::json!({ "every": "monthly", "keep": 7 });
        assert!(serde_json::from_value::<VmSpec>(json).is_err());
    }

    #[test]
    fn validate_checks_schedule_keep() {
        let with_keep = |keep| {
            let mut s = sample();
            s.snapshot_schedule = Some(SnapshotSchedule {
                every: ScheduleEvery::Hourly,
                keep,
                memory: true,
            });
            s.validate()
        };
        assert_eq!(with_keep(1), Ok(()));
        assert_eq!(with_keep(MAX_SCHEDULE_KEEP), Ok(()));
        assert_eq!(with_keep(0), Err(ValidationError::ScheduleKeep));
        assert_eq!(
            with_keep(MAX_SCHEDULE_KEEP + 1),
            Err(ValidationError::ScheduleKeep)
        );
    }

    #[test]
    fn mac_parses_and_formats() {
        let mac: MacAddr = "52:54:00:AB:cd:0f".parse().unwrap();
        assert_eq!(mac.0, [0x52, 0x54, 0x00, 0xab, 0xcd, 0x0f]);
        assert_eq!(mac.to_string(), "52:54:00:ab:cd:0f");
        assert_eq!(serde_json::to_value(mac).unwrap(), "52:54:00:ab:cd:0f");
    }

    #[test]
    fn generated_mac_is_unicast_with_qemu_prefix() {
        let a = MacAddr::generate();
        let b = MacAddr::generate();
        assert_eq!(&a.0[..3], &[0x52, 0x54, 0x00]);
        assert_eq!(a.0[0] & 1, 0);
        assert_ne!(a, b);
    }

    #[test]
    fn mac_rejects_malformed() {
        for bad in [
            "",
            "52:54:00:ab:cd",
            "52:54:00:ab:cd:0f:11",
            "5:54:00:ab:cd:0f",
            "zz:54:00:ab:cd:0f",
            "+2:54:00:ab:cd:0f",
        ] {
            assert!(bad.parse::<MacAddr>().is_err(), "{bad} should be rejected");
        }
        assert!(serde_json::from_value::<MacAddr>("nope".into()).is_err());
    }
}
```

### Task 2: 핫플러그 배치 명령줄과 QMP 핫플러그 명령

opl-qemu `cmdline`: 배치가 있으면 빈 PCIe 루트 포트 `hp0..hp7`(슬롯 0x1e)을 USB 뒤·디스크 앞에, `-smp …,maxcpus`, 붙인 vCPU `-device`, virtio-mem(`-m …,maxmem`·`memory-backend-ram`·`virtio-mem-pci block-size=2M`), 실행 중 붙인 장치는 `bus=hp{port}` — 배치가 없으면 명령줄이 옛것과 바이트까지 같다. QMP `query_hotpluggable_cpus`·`query_cpus_fast`·`device_add`·`device_del_wait`(`DEVICE_DELETED`, `DeviceNotFound`·"already in the process of unplug")·`netdev_add/del`·`blockdev_add/del`·`qom_list/get/set`, 순수 `hotplug_caps(arch, linux, device_help)`. 실제 QEMU 시험 `tests/hotplug.rs`.

`crates/opl-qemu/src/cmdline.rs` 전체:

```rust
use std::path::Path;

use opl_types::runtime::{
    DiskKind, HOTPLUG_PORTS, HotplugLayout, ImageFormat, NicBackend, RbdTarget, VmRuntimeSpec,
};
use opl_types::vm::{Arch, CpuModel, DiskBus, Firmware, MachineType, NicModel};
use thiserror::Error;

use crate::host::{Accel, HostProfile};
use crate::paths::RuntimePaths;

/// q35의 내장 AHCI 컨트롤러 포트 수
const Q35_SATA_PORTS: usize = 6;

/// 핫플러그 루트 포트를 모아 두는 `pcie.0` 슬롯. 멀티펑션 8개(`0x1e.0`~`0x1e.7`)라 자동 주소를 밀지 않는다.
pub const HOTPLUG_SLOT: u8 = 0x1e;

/// virtio-mem 블록 크기. 마이그레이션 양쪽이 같게 박아 둔다.
pub const VIRTIO_MEM_BLOCK: &str = "2M";

#[derive(Debug, Error, PartialEq, Eq)]
pub enum CmdlineError {
    #[error("machine type {machine:?} is not supported on {arch:?} hosts")]
    MachineArchMismatch { machine: MachineType, arch: Arch },
    #[error("BIOS firmware is not supported on aarch64; use UEFI")]
    BiosOnAarch64,
    #[error("SATA disks require the q35 machine type")]
    SataRequiresQ35,
    #[error("at most {Q35_SATA_PORTS} SATA disks are supported")]
    TooManySataDisks,
    #[error("disk {0} is an rbd disk without an rbd image")]
    MissingRbdImage(usize),
    #[error("vCPU hotplug is not supported on aarch64")]
    CpuHotplugUnsupported,
    #[error("at most {HOTPLUG_PORTS} hotplug ports are supported")]
    TooManyPorts,
    #[error("{0} {1} was added while running but has no hotplug port")]
    MissingPort(&'static str, usize),
}

/// QEMU 인자 목록(바이너리 제외)을 만든다. 부수 효과가 없는 순수 함수다.
///
/// VM은 항상 `-S`(일시정지) 상태로 시작한다. 호출자는 QMP 연결 뒤 `cont`로 실행을 재개한다.
pub fn build_cmdline(
    spec: &VmRuntimeSpec,
    host: &HostProfile,
    paths: &RuntimePaths,
) -> Result<Vec<String>, CmdlineError> {
    check_compat(spec, host)?;

    let mut a = Args::default();
    a.opt(
        "-name",
        format!("guest={},debug-threads=on", esc(&spec.name)),
    );
    a.opt("-uuid", spec.id.to_string());
    a.flag("-no-user-config");
    a.flag("-nodefaults");
    a.flag("-S");
    let machine = match spec.machine {
        MachineType::Q35 => "q35",
        MachineType::Virt => "virt",
    };
    a.opt(
        "-machine",
        format!("{machine},accel={}", host.accel.as_str()),
    );
    let cpu = match (spec.cpu.model, host.accel) {
        (CpuModel::Host, Accel::Tcg) | (CpuModel::Max, _) => "max",
        (CpuModel::Host, _) => "host",
    };
    a.opt("-cpu", cpu.to_string());
    let layout = spec.hotplug.as_ref();
    let boot_vcpus = spec.cpu.vcpus();
    // vCPU 자리: 상한이 켤 때 수보다 크면 소켓마다 `max / sockets`개 코어 자리를 두고 앞에서부터 켠다.
    let max_vcpus = match (layout, spec.cpu.max_vcpus) {
        (Some(_), Some(max)) if u32::from(max) > boot_vcpus => Some(u32::from(max)),
        _ => None,
    };
    match max_vcpus {
        Some(max) => a.opt(
            "-smp",
            format!(
                "{boot_vcpus},sockets={},cores={},threads=1,maxcpus={max}",
                spec.cpu.sockets,
                max / u32::from(spec.cpu.sockets)
            ),
        ),
        None => a.opt(
            "-smp",
            format!(
                "sockets={},cores={},threads=1",
                spec.cpu.sockets, spec.cpu.cores
            ),
        ),
    }
    // virtio-mem: 켤 때 메모리 위로 상한까지의 자리
    let virtio_mem = layout.filter(|l| l.max_memory_mib > spec.memory_mib);
    match virtio_mem {
        Some(l) => a.opt(
            "-m",
            format!("{}M,maxmem={}M", spec.memory_mib, l.max_memory_mib),
        ),
        None => a.opt("-m", format!("{}M", spec.memory_mib)),
    }
    // 실행 중 붙인 vCPU(원본과 같은 id·자리)
    if let (Some(l), Some(max)) = (layout, max_vcpus) {
        let per_socket = max / u32::from(spec.cpu.sockets);
        for i in boot_vcpus..u32::from(l.vcpus) {
            a.opt(
                "-device",
                format!(
                    "{cpu}-x86_64-cpu,id=cpu{i},socket-id={},core-id={},thread-id=0",
                    i / per_socket,
                    i % per_socket
                ),
            );
        }
    }

    if spec.firmware == Firmware::Uefi {
        a.opt(
            "-drive",
            format!(
                "if=pflash,unit=0,format=raw,readonly=on,file={}",
                esc_path(&host.uefi_code)
            ),
        );
        a.opt(
            "-drive",
            format!(
                "if=pflash,unit=1,format=raw,file={}",
                esc_path(&paths.uefi_vars)
            ),
        );
    }

    let video = match host.arch {
        Arch::X86_64 => "VGA,id=video0",
        Arch::Aarch64 => "virtio-gpu-pci,id=video0",
    };
    a.opt("-device", video.to_string());
    a.opt("-device", "qemu-xhci,id=usb".to_string());
    a.opt("-device", "usb-tablet,bus=usb.0".to_string());
    a.opt("-device", "usb-kbd,bus=usb.0".to_string());

    // 빈 루트 포트: 주소를 박아 다른 장치의 자동 주소가 그대로다. 실행 중 붙인 장치가 쓰므로 디스크·NIC보다 먼저 둔다.
    if let Some(l) = layout {
        for k in 0..l.ports {
            let mut port = format!(
                "pcie-root-port,id=hp{k},bus=pcie.0,chassis={},addr={HOTPLUG_SLOT:#x}.{k},io-reserve=0",
                u16::from(k) + 1
            );
            if k == 0 {
                port.push_str(",multifunction=on");
            }
            a.opt("-device", port);
        }
    }

    let mut sata_port = 0;
    for (i, disk) in spec.disks.iter().enumerate() {
        let fmt = match disk.format {
            ImageFormat::Qcow2 => "qcow2",
            ImageFormat::Raw => "raw",
        };
        let source = match disk.kind {
            DiskKind::File => format!("driver=file,filename={}", esc_path(&disk.path)),
            DiskKind::Block => format!("driver=host_device,filename={}", esc_path(&disk.path)),
            DiskKind::Rbd => {
                let rbd = disk.rbd.as_ref().ok_or(CmdlineError::MissingRbdImage(i))?;
                rbd_source(rbd)
            }
        };
        a.opt("-blockdev", format!("{source},node-name=disk{i}-file"));
        a.opt(
            "-blockdev",
            format!("driver={fmt},file=disk{i}-file,node-name=disk{i}"),
        );
        let mut dev = match disk.bus {
            DiskBus::VirtioBlk => format!(
                "virtio-blk-pci,drive=disk{i},id=disk{i}-dev{}",
                hot_bus(layout.map(|l| (l.boot_disks, &l.disk_ports[..])), i)
            ),
            DiskBus::Sata => {
                let d = format!("ide-hd,drive=disk{i},bus=ide.{sata_port},id=disk{i}-dev");
                sata_port += 1;
                d
            }
        };
        if let Some(order) = disk.boot_order {
            dev.push_str(&format!(",bootindex={order}"));
        }
        a.opt("-device", dev);
    }

    for (i, nic) in spec.nics.iter().enumerate() {
        let netdev = match &nic.backend {
            NicBackend::User => format!("user,id=net{i}"),
            NicBackend::Tap { ifname, .. } => format!(
                "tap,id=net{i},ifname={},script=no,downscript=no",
                esc(ifname)
            ),
        };
        a.opt("-netdev", netdev);
        let model = match nic.model {
            NicModel::Virtio => "virtio-net-pci",
            NicModel::E1000e => "e1000e",
        };
        let mut dev = format!(
            "{model},netdev=net{i},mac={},id=nic{i}{}",
            nic.mac,
            hot_bus(layout.map(|l| (l.boot_nics, &l.nic_ports[..])), i)
        );
        // VXLAN 네트워크의 MTU를 게스트에 알린다(virtio만 받는다).
        if let (NicModel::Virtio, NicBackend::Tap { mtu: Some(mtu), .. }) =
            (nic.model, &nic.backend)
        {
            dev.push_str(&format!(",host_mtu={mtu}"));
        }
        a.opt("-device", dev);
    }

    // 게스트 에이전트 채널은 NIC 뒤에 단다(앞 장치들의 PCI 주소가 그대로다). 감시하는 VM만 단다.
    if spec.guest_agent {
        a.opt(
            "-chardev",
            format!(
                "socket,id=qga0,path={},server=on,wait=off",
                esc_path(&paths.qga_socket)
            ),
        );
        a.opt("-device", "virtio-serial-pci,id=qgaser".to_string());
        a.opt(
            "-device",
            "virtserialport,bus=qgaser.0,chardev=qga0,name=org.qemu.guest_agent.0".to_string(),
        );
    }

    // virtio-mem도 앞 장치들의 PCI 주소가 그대로이게 뒤에 단다. NUMA 노드는 `maxmem`이 있으면 QEMU가 만든다.
    if let Some(l) = virtio_mem {
        a.opt(
            "-object",
            format!(
                "memory-backend-ram,id=vmem0,size={}M",
                l.max_memory_mib - spec.memory_mib
            ),
        );
        a.opt(
            "-device",
            format!(
                "virtio-mem-pci,id=vmem0-dev,memdev=vmem0,block-size={VIRTIO_MEM_BLOCK},requested-size={}M",
                l.plugged_mib
            ),
        );
    }

    a.opt("-vnc", format!("unix:{}", esc_path(&paths.vnc_socket)));
    a.opt(
        "-qmp",
        format!("unix:{},server=on,wait=off", esc_path(&paths.qmp_socket)),
    );
    a.opt("-pidfile", paths.pidfile.display().to_string());
    Ok(a.0)
}

/// 라이브 마이그레이션을 받을 QEMU의 인자. [`build_cmdline`]과 같은 장치에 `-incoming defer`를 더한다.
/// QEMU는 QMP `migrate-incoming`을 받을 때까지 기다리고, 받은 뒤에도 `-S`라 `cont` 전까지 멈춰 있다.
pub fn build_incoming_cmdline(
    spec: &VmRuntimeSpec,
    host: &HostProfile,
    paths: &RuntimePaths,
) -> Result<Vec<String>, CmdlineError> {
    let mut args = build_cmdline(spec, host, paths)?;
    args.push("-incoming".into());
    args.push("defer".into());
    Ok(args)
}

/// 실행 중 붙인 장치(순번이 켤 때 수 이상)의 루트 포트 버스 옵션. 켤 때 단 장치는 `pcie.0`이라 빈 문자열이다.
/// 포트가 있는지는 [`check_compat`]이 먼저 본다.
fn hot_bus(ports: Option<(u8, &[u8])>, i: usize) -> String {
    match ports {
        Some((boot, ports)) if i >= usize::from(boot) => ports
            .get(i - usize::from(boot))
            .map_or_else(String::new, |p| format!(",bus=hp{p}")),
        _ => String::new(),
    }
}

/// RBD 이미지를 여는 `rbd` 블록 드라이버 옵션. 네임스페이스와 conf는 있을 때만 넣는다.
fn rbd_source(rbd: &RbdTarget) -> String {
    let mut s = format!("driver=rbd,pool={}", esc(&rbd.pool));
    if let Some(ns) = &rbd.namespace {
        s.push_str(&format!(",namespace={}", esc(ns)));
    }
    s.push_str(&format!(
        ",image={},user={}",
        esc(&rbd.image),
        esc(&rbd.user)
    ));
    if let Some(conf) = &rbd.conf {
        s.push_str(&format!(",conf={}", esc(conf)));
    }
    s
}

fn check_compat(spec: &VmRuntimeSpec, host: &HostProfile) -> Result<(), CmdlineError> {
    match (spec.machine, host.arch) {
        (MachineType::Q35, Arch::X86_64) | (MachineType::Virt, Arch::Aarch64) => {}
        (machine, arch) => return Err(CmdlineError::MachineArchMismatch { machine, arch }),
    }
    if host.arch == Arch::Aarch64 && spec.firmware == Firmware::Bios {
        return Err(CmdlineError::BiosOnAarch64);
    }
    let sata = spec.disks.iter().filter(|d| d.bus == DiskBus::Sata).count();
    if sata > 0 && spec.machine != MachineType::Q35 {
        return Err(CmdlineError::SataRequiresQ35);
    }
    if sata > Q35_SATA_PORTS {
        return Err(CmdlineError::TooManySataDisks);
    }
    if let Some(layout) = &spec.hotplug {
        check_layout(spec, host, layout)?;
    }
    Ok(())
}

fn check_layout(
    spec: &VmRuntimeSpec,
    host: &HostProfile,
    layout: &HotplugLayout,
) -> Result<(), CmdlineError> {
    // aarch64 `virt`는 CPU 핫플러그가 없다(QEMU 11.1까지).
    let boot = spec.cpu.vcpus();
    if host.arch == Arch::Aarch64 && (spec.cpu.max() > boot || u32::from(layout.vcpus) > boot) {
        return Err(CmdlineError::CpuHotplugUnsupported);
    }
    if layout.ports > HOTPLUG_PORTS {
        return Err(CmdlineError::TooManyPorts);
    }
    let missing = |kind, count: usize, boot: u8, ports: &[u8]| {
        (usize::from(boot)..count)
            .find(|&i| ports.get(i - usize::from(boot)).is_none())
            .map(|i| CmdlineError::MissingPort(kind, i))
    };
    if let Some(e) = missing(
        "disk",
        spec.disks.len(),
        layout.boot_disks,
        &layout.disk_ports,
    )
    .or_else(|| missing("nic", spec.nics.len(), layout.boot_nics, &layout.nic_ports))
    {
        return Err(e);
    }
    Ok(())
}

#[derive(Default)]
struct Args(Vec<String>);

impl Args {
    fn flag(&mut self, flag: &str) {
        self.0.push(flag.to_string());
    }

    fn opt(&mut self, flag: &str, value: String) {
        self.0.push(flag.to_string());
        self.0.push(value);
    }
}

/// QEMU 옵션 값 안의 쉼표는 두 번 써서 이스케이프한다.
fn esc(s: &str) -> String {
    s.replace(',', ",,")
}

fn esc_path(p: &Path) -> String {
    esc(&p.display().to_string())
}

#[cfg(test)]
mod tests {
    use std::path::PathBuf;

    use opl_types::runtime::{DiskKind, RbdTarget, RuntimeDisk, RuntimeNic};
    use opl_types::vm::CpuSpec;
    use uuid::Uuid;

    use super::*;

    fn x86_host() -> HostProfile {
        HostProfile {
            arch: Arch::X86_64,
            accel: Accel::Kvm,
            qemu_binary: PathBuf::from("/usr/bin/qemu-system-x86_64"),
            uefi_code: PathBuf::from("/usr/share/OVMF/OVMF_CODE.fd"),
            uefi_vars_template: PathBuf::from("/usr/share/OVMF/OVMF_VARS.fd"),
        }
    }

    fn mac_host() -> HostProfile {
        HostProfile::homebrew_hvf(Path::new("/opt/homebrew/share/qemu"))
    }

    fn paths() -> RuntimePaths {
        RuntimePaths::new(Path::new("/run/opl"), Uuid::nil()).unwrap()
    }

    fn x86_spec() -> VmRuntimeSpec {
        VmRuntimeSpec {
            id: Uuid::nil(),
            name: "web-01".into(),
            cpu: CpuSpec {
                sockets: 1,
                cores: 4,
                model: CpuModel::Host,
                max_vcpus: None,
            },
            memory_mib: 8192,
            firmware: Firmware::Uefi,
            machine: MachineType::Q35,
            disks: vec![
                RuntimeDisk {
                    path: "/var/lib/opl/pools/local/web-01-root.qcow2".into(),
                    kind: DiskKind::File,
                    rbd: None,
                    format: ImageFormat::Qcow2,
                    bus: DiskBus::VirtioBlk,
                    boot_order: Some(1),
                },
                RuntimeDisk {
                    path: "/var/lib/opl/pools/local/web-01-data.raw".into(),
                    kind: DiskKind::File,
                    rbd: None,
                    format: ImageFormat::Raw,
                    bus: DiskBus::Sata,
                    boot_order: None,
                },
            ],
            nics: vec![
                RuntimeNic {
                    mac: "52:54:00:12:34:56".parse().unwrap(),
                    model: NicModel::Virtio,
                    backend: NicBackend::Tap {
                        ifname: "tap0i0".into(),
                        bridge: "vmbr0".into(),
                        vlan: Some(10),
                        mtu: None,
                    },
                },
                RuntimeNic {
                    mac: "52:54:00:12:34:57".parse().unwrap(),
                    model: NicModel::E1000e,
                    backend: NicBackend::User,
                },
            ],
            guest_agent: false,
            hotplug: None,
        }
    }

    fn mac_spec() -> VmRuntimeSpec {
        VmRuntimeSpec {
            machine: MachineType::Virt,
            disks: vec![RuntimeDisk {
                path: "/tmp/opl/root.qcow2".into(),
                kind: DiskKind::File,
                rbd: None,
                format: ImageFormat::Qcow2,
                bus: DiskBus::VirtioBlk,
                boot_order: Some(1),
            }],
            nics: vec![RuntimeNic {
                mac: "52:54:00:12:34:56".parse().unwrap(),
                model: NicModel::Virtio,
                backend: NicBackend::User,
            }],
            ..x86_spec()
        }
    }

    #[test]
    fn x86_kvm_uefi_full() {
        let args = build_cmdline(&x86_spec(), &x86_host(), &paths()).unwrap();
        insta::assert_snapshot!(args.join("\n"));
    }

    #[test]
    fn aarch64_hvf_minimal() {
        let args = build_cmdline(&mac_spec(), &mac_host(), &paths()).unwrap();
        insta::assert_snapshot!(args.join("\n"));
    }

    /// 받는 쪽은 원본과 같은 장치(블록 노드 이름·장치 id)에 `-incoming defer`만 더한다.
    #[test]
    fn incoming_adds_defer_to_the_same_devices() {
        let normal = build_cmdline(&x86_spec(), &x86_host(), &paths()).unwrap();
        let incoming = build_incoming_cmdline(&x86_spec(), &x86_host(), &paths()).unwrap();
        assert_eq!(incoming[..normal.len()], normal[..]);
        assert_eq!(incoming[normal.len()..], ["-incoming", "defer"]);
        assert!(incoming.contains(&"-S".to_string()));
        assert!(!normal.contains(&"-incoming".to_string()));
        // 맞지 않는 조합은 똑같이 거절한다.
        assert_eq!(
            build_incoming_cmdline(&x86_spec(), &mac_host(), &paths()).unwrap_err(),
            CmdlineError::MachineArchMismatch {
                machine: MachineType::Q35,
                arch: Arch::Aarch64
            }
        );
    }

    /// VXLAN 네트워크의 MTU는 virtio NIC에만 `host_mtu`로 알린다.
    #[test]
    fn tap_mtu_sets_virtio_host_mtu() {
        let mut spec = x86_spec();
        let tap = NicBackend::Tap {
            ifname: "tap0i0".into(),
            bridge: "oplv1000".into(),
            vlan: None,
            mtu: Some(1450),
        };
        spec.nics[0].backend = tap.clone();
        spec.nics[1].backend = tap;
        let args = build_cmdline(&spec, &x86_host(), &paths()).unwrap();
        assert!(args.contains(
            &"virtio-net-pci,netdev=net0,mac=52:54:00:12:34:56,id=nic0,host_mtu=1450".to_string()
        ));
        assert!(args.contains(&"e1000e,netdev=net1,mac=52:54:00:12:34:57,id=nic1".to_string()));
    }

    /// 게스트 감시를 켠 VM만 QGA 채널(소켓 서버, virtio-serial 포트)을 단다. 받는 쪽도 같다. aarch64(virt)도
    /// PCI 장치를 쓴다.
    #[test]
    fn guest_agent_adds_a_qga_channel() {
        let qga = [
            "-chardev",
            "socket,id=qga0,path=/run/opl/vm/00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000/qga.sock,server=on,wait=off",
            "-device",
            "virtio-serial-pci,id=qgaser",
            "-device",
            "virtserialport,bus=qgaser.0,chardev=qga0,name=org.qemu.guest_agent.0",
        ];
        for (spec, host) in [(x86_spec(), x86_host()), (mac_spec(), mac_host())] {
            let without = build_cmdline(&spec, &host, &paths()).unwrap();
            assert!(!without.iter().any(|a| a.contains("qga")), "{without:?}");
            let watched = VmRuntimeSpec {
                guest_agent: true,
                ..spec
            };
            let with = build_cmdline(&watched, &host, &paths()).unwrap();
            let at = with.iter().position(|a| a == "-chardev").unwrap();
            assert_eq!(with[at..at + qga.len()], qga);
            // 앞 장치(디스크·NIC)의 순서는 그대로이고 채널만 끼어든다.
            assert_eq!(with[..at], without[..at]);
            assert_eq!(with[at + qga.len()..], without[at..]);
            let incoming = build_incoming_cmdline(&watched, &host, &paths()).unwrap();
            assert_eq!(incoming[..with.len()], with[..]);
        }
    }

    #[test]
    fn bios_omits_pflash() {
        let spec = VmRuntimeSpec {
            firmware: Firmware::Bios,
            ..x86_spec()
        };
        let args = build_cmdline(&spec, &x86_host(), &paths()).unwrap();
        assert!(!args.iter().any(|a| a.contains("pflash")));
    }

    #[test]
    fn host_cpu_falls_back_to_max_under_tcg() {
        let host = HostProfile {
            accel: Accel::Tcg,
            ..x86_host()
        };
        let args = build_cmdline(&x86_spec(), &host, &paths()).unwrap();
        let i = args.iter().position(|a| a == "-cpu").unwrap();
        assert_eq!(args[i + 1], "max");
        assert!(args.contains(&"q35,accel=tcg".to_string()));
    }

    #[test]
    fn escapes_commas_in_names_and_paths() {
        let mut spec = x86_spec();
        spec.name = "a,b".into();
        spec.disks[0].path = "/pool/x,y.qcow2".into();
        let args = build_cmdline(&spec, &x86_host(), &paths()).unwrap();
        assert!(args.contains(&"guest=a,,b,debug-threads=on".to_string()));
        assert!(
            args.contains(
                &"driver=file,filename=/pool/x,,y.qcow2,node-name=disk0-file".to_string()
            )
        );
    }

    /// 블록 장치 디스크는 `host_device`로 연다. 포맷 노드는 파일 디스크와 같다.
    #[test]
    fn block_disks_use_host_device() {
        let mut spec = x86_spec();
        spec.disks[1].path = "/dev/vg0/opl-a".into();
        spec.disks[1].kind = DiskKind::Block;
        let args = build_cmdline(&spec, &x86_host(), &paths()).unwrap();
        assert!(args.contains(
            &"driver=host_device,filename=/dev/vg0/opl-a,node-name=disk1-file".to_string()
        ));
        assert!(args.contains(&"driver=raw,file=disk1-file,node-name=disk1".to_string()));
        assert!(args.contains(
            &"driver=file,filename=/var/lib/opl/pools/local/web-01-root.qcow2,node-name=disk0-file"
                .to_string()
        ));
    }

    /// RBD 디스크는 QEMU의 `rbd` 드라이버로 연다. 네임스페이스와 conf는 있을 때만 넘긴다.
    #[test]
    fn rbd_disks_use_rbd_driver() {
        let mut spec = x86_spec();
        spec.disks[0] = RuntimeDisk {
            path: PathBuf::new(),
            kind: DiskKind::Rbd,
            rbd: Some(RbdTarget {
                pool: "rbd".into(),
                namespace: Some("opl".into()),
                image: "opl-a".into(),
                user: "opl".into(),
                conf: Some("/etc/ceph/opl.conf".into()),
            }),
            format: ImageFormat::Raw,
            ..spec.disks[0].clone()
        };
        spec.disks[1].path = PathBuf::new();
        spec.disks[1].kind = DiskKind::Rbd;
        spec.disks[1].rbd = Some(RbdTarget {
            pool: "rbd".into(),
            namespace: None,
            image: "opl-b".into(),
            user: "admin".into(),
            conf: None,
        });
        let args = build_cmdline(&spec, &x86_host(), &paths()).unwrap();
        assert!(args.contains(
            &"driver=rbd,pool=rbd,namespace=opl,image=opl-a,user=opl,conf=/etc/ceph/opl.conf,node-name=disk0-file"
                .to_string()
        ));
        assert!(args.contains(&"driver=raw,file=disk0-file,node-name=disk0".to_string()));
        assert!(args.contains(
            &"driver=rbd,pool=rbd,image=opl-b,user=admin,node-name=disk1-file".to_string()
        ));
        assert!(args.contains(&"driver=raw,file=disk1-file,node-name=disk1".to_string()));
        // 이미지가 없는 RBD 디스크는 열 수 없다.
        spec.disks[1].rbd = None;
        assert_eq!(
            build_cmdline(&spec, &x86_host(), &paths()).unwrap_err(),
            CmdlineError::MissingRbdImage(1)
        );
    }

    /// 핫플러그 배치: 켤 때 vCPU 2·상한 8·지금 4, virtio-mem 4096+12288(꽂은 2048), 포트 8, 실행 중 붙인 디스크(hp0)와
    /// NIC(hp1) 하나씩.
    fn hotplug_spec() -> VmRuntimeSpec {
        let mut spec = x86_spec();
        spec.cpu.cores = 2;
        spec.cpu.max_vcpus = Some(8);
        spec.memory_mib = 4096;
        spec.disks.push(RuntimeDisk {
            path: "/var/lib/opl/pools/local/web-01-hot.qcow2".into(),
            kind: DiskKind::File,
            rbd: None,
            format: ImageFormat::Qcow2,
            bus: DiskBus::VirtioBlk,
            boot_order: None,
        });
        spec.nics.push(RuntimeNic {
            mac: "52:54:00:12:34:58".parse().unwrap(),
            model: NicModel::Virtio,
            backend: NicBackend::User,
        });
        spec.hotplug = Some(HotplugLayout {
            vcpus: 4,
            max_memory_mib: 16384,
            plugged_mib: 2048,
            ports: HOTPLUG_PORTS,
            boot_disks: 2,
            boot_nics: 2,
            disk_ports: vec![0],
            nic_ports: vec![1],
        });
        spec
    }

    #[test]
    fn x86_kvm_hotplug_layout() {
        let args = build_cmdline(&hotplug_spec(), &x86_host(), &paths()).unwrap();
        insta::assert_snapshot!(args.join("\n"));
    }

    /// 배치가 없으면 상한이 있어도 옛 명령줄과 바이트까지 같다.
    #[test]
    fn without_a_layout_the_maximums_change_nothing() {
        let mut spec = x86_spec();
        let before = build_cmdline(&spec, &x86_host(), &paths()).unwrap();
        spec.cpu.max_vcpus = Some(16);
        assert_eq!(build_cmdline(&spec, &x86_host(), &paths()).unwrap(), before);
    }

    /// 상한이 없는 배치는 `-smp`·`-m`이 그대로이고 빈 루트 포트만 더한다.
    #[test]
    fn a_layout_without_maximums_adds_only_root_ports() {
        let mut spec = x86_spec();
        let before = build_cmdline(&spec, &x86_host(), &paths()).unwrap();
        spec.hotplug = Some(HotplugLayout {
            vcpus: 4,
            max_memory_mib: 8192,
            plugged_mib: 0,
            ports: HOTPLUG_PORTS,
            boot_disks: 2,
            boot_nics: 2,
            disk_ports: vec![],
            nic_ports: vec![],
        });
        let after = build_cmdline(&spec, &x86_host(), &paths()).unwrap();
        let ports: Vec<String> = (0..8)
            .flat_map(|k| {
                let mut port = format!(
                    "pcie-root-port,id=hp{k},bus=pcie.0,chassis={},addr=0x1e.{k},io-reserve=0",
                    k + 1
                );
                if k == 0 {
                    port.push_str(",multifunction=on");
                }
                ["-device".to_string(), port]
            })
            .collect();
        let at = after
            .iter()
            .position(|a| a.starts_with("pcie-root-port"))
            .unwrap()
            - 1;
        assert_eq!(after[at..at + ports.len()], ports[..]);
        assert_eq!(after[..at], before[..at]);
        assert_eq!(after[at + ports.len()..], before[at..]);
        assert!(after.contains(&"sockets=1,cores=4,threads=1".to_string()));
        assert!(after.contains(&"8192M".to_string()));
    }

    /// 실행 중 붙인 디스크·NIC는 루트 포트에 놓여 `pcie.0` 슬롯을 먹지 않는다: 그것을 빼면 나머지 인자가 배치만 있는
    /// 명령줄과 같다. 받는 쪽도 같은 배치다.
    #[test]
    fn hot_added_devices_go_on_root_ports() {
        let spec = hotplug_spec();
        let args = build_cmdline(&spec, &x86_host(), &paths()).unwrap();
        assert!(args.contains(&"virtio-blk-pci,drive=disk2,id=disk2-dev,bus=hp0".to_string()));
        assert!(args.contains(
            &"virtio-net-pci,netdev=net2,mac=52:54:00:12:34:58,id=nic2,bus=hp1".to_string()
        ));
        // 켤 때 단 장치에는 버스가 없다.
        assert!(args.contains(&"virtio-blk-pci,drive=disk0,id=disk0-dev,bootindex=1".to_string()));
        let mut fewer = spec.clone();
        fewer.disks.pop();
        fewer.nics.pop();
        let layout = fewer.hotplug.as_mut().unwrap();
        layout.disk_ports.clear();
        layout.nic_ports.clear();
        let without = build_cmdline(&fewer, &x86_host(), &paths()).unwrap();
        let hot = |a: &String| a.contains("disk2") || a.contains("net2") || a.contains("nic2");
        let kept: Vec<&String> = args
            .iter()
            .enumerate()
            .filter(|(i, a)| !hot(a) && !args.get(i + 1).is_some_and(hot))
            .map(|(_, a)| a)
            .collect();
        assert_eq!(kept, without.iter().collect::<Vec<_>>());
        let incoming = build_incoming_cmdline(&spec, &x86_host(), &paths()).unwrap();
        assert_eq!(incoming[..args.len()], args[..]);
    }

    /// aarch64(`virt`)는 CPU 핫플러그가 없으므로 vCPU 상한이나 붙인 vCPU가 있는 배치를 거절한다. 디스크·NIC 포트는 된다.
    #[test]
    fn aarch64_rejects_cpu_hotplug() {
        let layout = HotplugLayout {
            vcpus: 4,
            max_memory_mib: 8192,
            plugged_mib: 0,
            ports: HOTPLUG_PORTS,
            boot_disks: 1,
            boot_nics: 1,
            disk_ports: vec![],
            nic_ports: vec![],
        };
        let spec = VmRuntimeSpec {
            hotplug: Some(layout.clone()),
            ..mac_spec()
        };
        let args = build_cmdline(&spec, &mac_host(), &paths()).unwrap();
        assert!(args.contains(&"sockets=1,cores=4,threads=1".to_string()));
        assert!(args.iter().any(|a| a.starts_with("pcie-root-port,id=hp7")));
        let mut max = spec.clone();
        max.cpu.max_vcpus = Some(8);
        assert_eq!(
            build_cmdline(&max, &mac_host(), &paths()).unwrap_err(),
            CmdlineError::CpuHotplugUnsupported
        );
        let mut added = spec;
        added.hotplug = Some(HotplugLayout { vcpus: 5, ..layout });
        assert_eq!(
            build_incoming_cmdline(&added, &mac_host(), &paths()).unwrap_err(),
            CmdlineError::CpuHotplugUnsupported
        );
    }

    #[test]
    fn rejects_bad_layouts() {
        let err = |spec: &VmRuntimeSpec| build_cmdline(spec, &x86_host(), &paths()).unwrap_err();
        let mut many = hotplug_spec();
        many.hotplug.as_mut().unwrap().ports = HOTPLUG_PORTS + 1;
        assert_eq!(err(&many), CmdlineError::TooManyPorts);
        let mut no_disk_port = hotplug_spec();
        no_disk_port.hotplug.as_mut().unwrap().disk_ports.clear();
        assert_eq!(err(&no_disk_port), CmdlineError::MissingPort("disk", 2));
        let mut no_nic_port = hotplug_spec();
        no_nic_port.hotplug.as_mut().unwrap().nic_ports.clear();
        assert_eq!(err(&no_nic_port), CmdlineError::MissingPort("nic", 2));
    }

    #[test]
    fn rejects_incompatible_combinations() {
        let err = |spec: &VmRuntimeSpec, host: &HostProfile| {
            build_cmdline(spec, host, &paths()).unwrap_err()
        };
        assert_eq!(
            err(&x86_spec(), &mac_host()),
            CmdlineError::MachineArchMismatch {
                machine: MachineType::Q35,
                arch: Arch::Aarch64
            }
        );
        assert_eq!(
            err(
                &VmRuntimeSpec {
                    firmware: Firmware::Bios,
                    ..mac_spec()
                },
                &mac_host()
            ),
            CmdlineError::BiosOnAarch64
        );
        let mut sata_on_virt = mac_spec();
        sata_on_virt.disks[0].bus = DiskBus::Sata;
        assert_eq!(
            err(&sata_on_virt, &mac_host()),
            CmdlineError::SataRequiresQ35
        );
        let mut many = x86_spec();
        many.disks = (0..7)
            .map(|i| RuntimeDisk {
                path: format!("/d{i}.raw").into(),
                kind: DiskKind::File,
                rbd: None,
                format: ImageFormat::Raw,
                bus: DiskBus::Sata,
                boot_order: None,
            })
            .collect();
        assert_eq!(err(&many, &x86_host()), CmdlineError::TooManySataDisks);
    }
}
```

```rust
/// `query-hotpluggable-cpus`의 CPU 자리 하나
#[derive(Debug, Clone, PartialEq, Eq)]
pub struct HotpluggableCpu {
    /// `device_add`에 줄 CPU 장치 이름(`type`, 예: `max-x86_64-cpu`)
    pub kind: String,
    pub vcpus_count: u32,
    pub socket_id: Option<u32>,
    pub core_id: Option<u32>,
    pub thread_id: Option<u32>,
    /// 켜진 자리의 QOM 경로. 빈 자리는 없다.
    pub qom_path: Option<String>,
}

impl HotpluggableCpu {
    fn parse(v: &Value) -> Result<Self, QmpError> {
        let kind = v["type"]
            .as_str()
            .ok_or_else(|| QmpError::Protocol(format!("hotpluggable cpu without type: {v}")))?;
        let prop = |k: &str| v["props"][k].as_u64().and_then(|n| u32::try_from(n).ok());
        Ok(Self {
            kind: kind.to_string(),
            vcpus_count: v["vcpus-count"]
                .as_u64()
                .and_then(|n| u32::try_from(n).ok())
                .unwrap_or(1),
            socket_id: prop("socket-id"),
            core_id: prop("core-id"),
            thread_id: prop("thread-id"),
            qom_path: v["qom-path"].as_str().map(str::to_string),
        })
    }
```

```rust
    /// CPU 자리 목록(`query-hotpluggable-cpus`). 켜진 자리만 `qom_path`가 있다. CPU 핫플러그가 없는 머신
    /// (aarch64 `virt`)은 `GenericError`다.
    pub async fn query_hotpluggable_cpus(&self) -> Result<Vec<HotpluggableCpu>, QmpError> {
        let ret = self.execute("query-hotpluggable-cpus", None).await?;
        ret.as_array()
            .ok_or_else(|| QmpError::Protocol(format!("query-hotpluggable-cpus: {ret}")))?
            .iter()
            .map(HotpluggableCpu::parse)
            .collect()
    }

    /// 켜진 vCPU 수(`query-cpus-fast`)
    pub async fn query_cpus_fast(&self) -> Result<usize, QmpError> {
        let ret = self.execute("query-cpus-fast", None).await?;
        ret.as_array()
            .map(Vec::len)
            .ok_or_else(|| QmpError::Protocol(format!("query-cpus-fast: {ret}")))
    }

    /// 장치를 붙인다(`device_add`, 인자는 `driver`·`id`와 장치 속성).
    pub async fn device_add(&self, args: Value) -> Result<(), QmpError> {
        self.execute("device_add", Some(args)).await.map(drop)
    }

    /// 장치 `id`를 떼고 `DEVICE_DELETED`를 `timeout`까지 기다린다. 뗐으면(이미 없었으면) true, 게스트가 시간 안에
    /// 내려 주지 않았으면 false다(요청은 QEMU에 남아 게스트가 나중에 내려 줄 수 있다).
    pub async fn device_del_wait(&self, id: &str, timeout: Duration) -> Result<bool, QmpError> {
        // 이벤트가 `device_del`의 답보다 먼저 와도 놓치지 않게 보내기 전에 구독한다.
        let mut events = self.subscribe();
        let run = async {
            match self.execute("device_del", Some(json!({ "id": id }))).await {
                Ok(_) => {}
                Err(QmpError::Command { class, .. }) if class == "DeviceNotFound" => {
                    return Ok(true);
                }
                Err(e) => return Err(e),
            }
            loop {
                match events.recv().await {
                    Ok(ev) => {
                        if ev.event == "DEVICE_DELETED" && ev.data["device"] == id {
                            return Ok(true);
                        }
                    }
                    // 이벤트를 놓쳤으면 장치가 아직 있는지 직접 본다.
                    Err(RecvError::Lagged(_)) => {
                        if !self.peripheral_exists(id).await? {
                            return Ok(true);
                        }
                    }
                    Err(RecvError::Closed) => return Err(QmpError::Disconnected),
                }
            }
        };
        match tokio::time::timeout(timeout, run).await {
            Ok(r) => r,
            Err(_) => Ok(false),
        }
    }

    /// id를 준 장치 `id`가 아직 있는지(`/machine/peripheral`의 자식)
    async fn peripheral_exists(&self, id: &str) -> Result<bool, QmpError> {
        let ret = self
            .execute("qom-list", Some(json!({ "path": "/machine/peripheral" })))
            .await?;
        let children = ret
            .as_array()
            .ok_or_else(|| QmpError::Protocol(format!("qom-list: {ret}")))?;
        Ok(children.iter().any(|c| c["name"] == id))
    }

    /// 네트워크 백엔드를 만든다(`netdev_add`, 인자는 `type`·`id`와 백엔드 속성).
    pub async fn netdev_add(&self, args: Value) -> Result<(), QmpError> {
        self.execute("netdev_add", Some(args)).await.map(drop)
    }

    /// 네트워크 백엔드 `id`를 지운다.
    pub async fn netdev_del(&self, id: &str) -> Result<(), QmpError> {
        self.execute("netdev_del", Some(json!({ "id": id })))
            .await
            .map(drop)
    }

    /// 블록 노드를 연다(`blockdev-add`, 인자는 `driver`·`node-name`과 드라이버 속성).
    pub async fn blockdev_add(&self, args: Value) -> Result<(), QmpError> {
        self.execute("blockdev-add", Some(args)).await.map(drop)
    }

    /// QOM 객체 `path`의 속성 `property`를 읽는다.
    pub async fn qom_get(&self, path: &str, property: &str) -> Result<Value, QmpError> {
        self.execute(
            "qom-get",
            Some(json!({ "path": path, "property": property })),
        )
        .await
    }

    /// QOM 객체 `path`의 속성 `property`를 `value`로 바꾼다. 예: virtio-mem의 `requested-size`(바이트)
    pub async fn qom_set(&self, path: &str, property: &str, value: Value) -> Result<(), QmpError> {
        self.execute(
            "qom-set",
            Some(json!({ "path": path, "property": property, "value": value })),
        )
        .await
        .map(drop)
    }
```

```rust
    /// 핫플러그 명령은 받은 인자를 그대로 보낸다.
    #[tokio::test]
    async fn hotplug_commands_send_their_arguments() {
        let (client, mut fake, _dir) = setup().await;
        let dev = json!({ "driver": "virtio-blk-pci", "drive": "disk1", "id": "disk1-dev", "bus": "hp0" });
        let (r, cmd) = tokio::join!(client.device_add(dev.clone()), reply(&mut fake, json!({})));
        r.unwrap();
        assert_eq!(
            (&cmd["execute"], &cmd["arguments"]),
            (&json!("device_add"), &dev)
        );

        let file = json!({ "driver": "file", "filename": "/p/b.qcow2", "node-name": "disk1-file" });
        let (r, cmd) = tokio::join!(
            client.blockdev_add(file.clone()),
            reply(&mut fake, json!({}))
        );
        r.unwrap();
        assert_eq!(
            (&cmd["execute"], &cmd["arguments"]),
            (&json!("blockdev-add"), &file)
        );

        let tap = json!({ "type": "tap", "id": "net1", "ifname": "op0n1", "script": "no", "downscript": "no" });
        let (r, cmd) = tokio::join!(client.netdev_add(tap.clone()), reply(&mut fake, json!({})));
        r.unwrap();
        assert_eq!(
            (&cmd["execute"], &cmd["arguments"]),
            (&json!("netdev_add"), &tap)
        );

        let (r, cmd) = tokio::join!(client.netdev_del("net1"), reply(&mut fake, json!({})));
        r.unwrap();
        assert_eq!(cmd["execute"], "netdev_del");
        assert_eq!(cmd["arguments"], json!({ "id": "net1" }));

        let path = "/machine/peripheral/vmem0-dev";
        let (r, cmd) = tokio::join!(
            client.qom_set(path, "requested-size", json!(1u64 << 30)),
            reply(&mut fake, json!({}))
        );
        r.unwrap();
        assert_eq!(cmd["execute"], "qom-set");
        assert_eq!(
            cmd["arguments"],
            json!({ "path": path, "property": "requested-size", "value": 1u64 << 30 })
        );

        let (r, cmd) = tokio::join!(
            client.qom_get(path, "size"),
            reply(&mut fake, json!(536870912u64))
        );
        assert_eq!(r.unwrap(), json!(536870912u64));
        assert_eq!(cmd["execute"], "qom-get");
        assert_eq!(
            cmd["arguments"],
            json!({ "path": path, "property": "size" })
        );

        let cpus = json!([
            { "cpu-index": 0, "qom-path": "/machine/unattached/device[0]", "thread-id": 1, "target": "x86_64" },
            { "cpu-index": 1, "qom-path": "/machine/peripheral/cpu1", "thread-id": 2, "target": "x86_64" }
        ]);
        let (r, cmd) = tokio::join!(client.query_cpus_fast(), reply(&mut fake, cpus));
        assert_eq!(r.unwrap(), 2);
        assert_eq!(cmd["execute"], "query-cpus-fast");
    }

    /// QEMU 11.1 q35의 `query-hotpluggable-cpus` 모양: 켜진 자리만 `qom-path`가 있다.
    #[tokio::test]
    async fn hotpluggable_cpus_are_parsed() {
        let (client, mut fake, _dir) = setup().await;
        let ret = json!([
            { "props": { "core-id": 1, "thread-id": 0, "socket-id": 0 }, "vcpus-count": 1,
              "type": "max-x86_64-cpu" },
            { "props": { "core-id": 0, "thread-id": 0, "socket-id": 0 }, "vcpus-count": 1,
              "qom-path": "/machine/unattached/device[0]", "type": "max-x86_64-cpu" }
        ]);
        let (cpus, cmd) = tokio::join!(client.query_hotpluggable_cpus(), reply(&mut fake, ret));
        assert_eq!(cmd["execute"], "query-hotpluggable-cpus");
        let slot = |core, qom_path: Option<&str>| HotpluggableCpu {
            kind: "max-x86_64-cpu".into(),
            vcpus_count: 1,
            socket_id: Some(0),
            core_id: Some(core),
            thread_id: Some(0),
            qom_path: qom_path.map(Into::into),
        };
        assert_eq!(
            cpus.unwrap(),
            [
                slot(1, None),
                slot(0, Some("/machine/unattached/device[0]"))
            ]
        );
        let (cpus, _) = tokio::join!(
            client.query_hotpluggable_cpus(),
            reply(&mut fake, json!([{ "props": {} }]))
        );
        assert!(matches!(cpus, Err(QmpError::Protocol(_))), "{cpus:?}");
    }

    /// `DEVICE_DELETED`가 `device_del`의 답보다 먼저 와도 잡고, 다른 장치의 이벤트는 무시한다.
    #[tokio::test]
    async fn device_del_wait_catches_the_event_even_before_the_reply() {
        let (client, mut fake, _dir) = setup().await;
        let (r, ()) = tokio::join!(client.device_del_wait("disk1-dev", T), async {
            let cmd = fake.recv().await;
            assert_eq!(cmd["execute"], "device_del");
            assert_eq!(cmd["arguments"], json!({ "id": "disk1-dev" }));
            let deleted = |device: &str| {
                json!({ "event": "DEVICE_DELETED", "timestamp": {},
                        "data": { "device": device, "path": format!("/machine/peripheral/{device}") } })
            };
            fake.send(deleted("nic1")).await;
            fake.send(deleted("disk1-dev")).await;
            fake.send(json!({ "return": {}, "id": cmd["id"] })).await;
        });
        assert!(r.unwrap());
    }

    /// 다른 장치의 이벤트만 오고 시간이 넘으면 false다(게스트가 내려 주지 않음).
    #[tokio::test]
    async fn device_del_wait_is_false_when_the_guest_does_not_release() {
        let (client, mut fake, _dir) = setup().await;
        let (r, _fake) = tokio::join!(
            client.device_del_wait("cpu3", Duration::from_millis(200)),
            async {
                let cmd = fake.recv().await;
                fake.send(json!({ "return": {}, "id": cmd["id"] })).await;
                fake.send(json!({ "event": "DEVICE_DELETED", "timestamp": {},
                                  "data": { "device": "cpu2", "path": "/machine/peripheral/cpu2" } }))
                    .await;
                fake
            }
        );
        assert!(!r.unwrap());
    }

    /// 이미 없는 장치(`DeviceNotFound`)는 뗀 것이다. 다른 오류는 그대로 돌려준다.
    #[tokio::test]
    async fn device_del_wait_treats_a_missing_device_as_removed() {
        let (client, mut fake, _dir) = setup().await;
        let (r, ()) = tokio::join!(client.device_del_wait("nic2", T), async {
            fake.answer(
                "device_del",
                json!({ "error": { "class": "DeviceNotFound", "desc": "Device 'nic2' not found" } }),
            )
            .await;
        });
        assert!(r.unwrap());
        let (r, ()) = tokio::join!(client.device_del_wait("nic2", T), async {
            fake.answer(
                "device_del",
                json!({ "error": { "class": "GenericError", "desc": "Bus 'pcie.0' does not support hotplugging" } }),
            )
            .await;
        });
        assert!(matches!(r, Err(QmpError::Command { .. })), "{r:?}");
    }

    /// 이벤트를 놓치면(`Lagged`) `/machine/peripheral`에 장치가 남았는지 직접 본다.
    #[tokio::test]
    async fn device_del_wait_checks_the_device_after_lagging() {
        let (client, mut fake, _dir) = setup().await;
        let (r, ()) = tokio::join!(client.device_del_wait("disk1-dev", T), async {
            let cmd = fake.recv().await;
            for _ in 0..100 {
                job_status(&mut fake, &json!("other"), "running").await;
            }
            fake.send(json!({ "return": {}, "id": cmd["id"] })).await;
            let list = fake.recv().await;
            assert_eq!(list["execute"], "qom-list");
            assert_eq!(list["arguments"], json!({ "path": "/machine/peripheral" }));
            fake.send(json!({ "return": [{ "name": "type", "type": "string" },
                                         { "name": "disk0-dev", "type": "child<virtio-blk-pci>" }],
                              "id": list["id"] }))
                .await;
        });
        assert!(r.unwrap());
    }
}
```
