    /// `node fence set -f`는 파일을 그대로 PUT하고, `get`은 비밀번호 없이 표로 보인다.
    #[tokio::test]
    async fn node_fence_puts_the_file_and_shows_methods() {
        let dir = tempfile::TempDir::new().unwrap();
        let file = dir.path().join("fence.json");
        std::fs::write(
            &file,
            r#"{"methods": [{"kind": "ipmi", "address": "10.0.0.9", "user": "admin", "password": "pw"}]}"#,
        )
        .unwrap();
        let view = json!({ "node": "n1", "revision": 7, "methods": [
            { "kind": "ipmi", "address": "10.0.0.9", "port": 623, "user": "admin", "lanplus": true, "has_password": true },
            { "kind": "redfish", "url": "https://bmc", "user": "root", "system_id": "1", "insecure": false, "has_password": false },
            { "kind": "command", "off": "pdu off 3", "status": "pdu status 3" },
        ]});
        assert_eq!(
            fence_rows(&view),
            [
                ["1", "ipmi", "10.0.0.9:623", "admin", "set"],
                ["2", "redfish", "https://bmc#1", "root", "-"],
                ["3", "command", "pdu off 3", "-", "-"],
            ]
        );
        let (client, seen) =
            fake_api(|_| json!({ "node": "n1", "methods": [{ "kind": "ipmi" }] })).await;
        let argv = [
            "oplctl",
            "node",
            "fence",
            "set",
            "n1",
            "-f",
            file.to_str().unwrap(),
        ];
        let Cmd::Node {
            cmd: NodeCmd::Fence { cmd },
        } = Cli::try_parse_from(argv).unwrap().cmd
        else {
            unreachable!()
        };
        let mut out = Vec::new();
        node_fence(&client, cmd, false, &mut out).await.unwrap();
        assert_eq!(
            String::from_utf8(out).unwrap(),
            "node n1: power fencing set (1 methods)\n"
        );
        for (argv, expected) in [
            (
                vec!["oplctl", "node", "fence", "get", "n1"],
                "GET /api/v1/nodes/n1/fence HTTP/1.1",
            ),
            (
                vec!["oplctl", "node", "fence", "delete", "n1"],
                "DELETE /api/v1/nodes/n1/fence HTTP/1.1",
            ),
        ] {
            let Cmd::Node {
                cmd: NodeCmd::Fence { cmd },
            } = Cli::try_parse_from(argv).unwrap().cmd
            else {
                unreachable!()
            };
            node_fence(&client, cmd, false, &mut Vec::new())
                .await
                .unwrap();
            assert_eq!(seen.lock().unwrap().last().unwrap(), expected);
        }
        assert_eq!(
            seen.lock().unwrap()[0],
            "PUT /api/v1/nodes/n1/fence HTTP/1.1"
        );
        // 파일은 꼭 줘야 한다.
        assert!(Cli::try_parse_from(["oplctl", "node", "fence", "set", "n1"]).is_err());
    }

    /// 파일에 `revision`이 있으면(`get --json`의 출력) `If-Match`로 보내고 본문에서는 뺀다. 없으면 보내지 않는다.
    #[tokio::test]
    async fn node_fence_set_sends_the_revision_of_the_file_as_if_match() {
        let dir = tempfile::TempDir::new().unwrap();
        let (base, seen) =
            fake_api_bodies(|_| json!({ "node": "n1", "methods": [{ "kind": "ipmi" }] })).await;
        let client = Client::new(&base, None, None).unwrap();
        for (text, expected) in [
            (
                r#"{"node": "n1", "revision": 7, "methods": [{"kind": "command", "off": "o", "status": "s"}]}"#,
                Some("7"),
            ),
            (
                r#"{"methods": [{"kind": "command", "off": "o", "status": "s"}]}"#,
                None,
            ),
        ] {
            let file = dir.path().join("fence.json");
            std::fs::write(&file, text).unwrap();
            let cmd = FenceCmd::Set {
                node: "n1".into(),
                file,
            };
            node_fence(&client, cmd, false, &mut Vec::new())
                .await
                .unwrap();
            let seen = seen.lock().unwrap();
            let last = seen.last().unwrap();
            assert_eq!(last.line, "PUT /api/v1/nodes/n1/fence HTTP/1.1");
            assert_eq!(last.if_match.as_deref(), expected, "{text}");
            assert_eq!(
                last.body,
                json!({ "methods": [{ "kind": "command", "off": "o", "status": "s" }] })
            );
        }
    }

    /// `node fence get --json`의 출력을 그대로 `set -f`에 줄 수 있다: 읽기 전용 필드는 빼고 보낸다.
    #[test]
    fn fence_body_drops_the_read_only_fields_of_get() {
        let view = json!({ "node": "n1", "revision": 7, "methods": [
            { "kind": "ipmi", "address": "10.0.0.9", "port": 623, "user": "admin", "lanplus": true, "has_password": true },
            { "kind": "command", "off": "pdu off 3", "status": "pdu status 3" },
        ]});
        assert_eq!(
            fence_body(view),
            json!({ "methods": [
                { "kind": "ipmi", "address": "10.0.0.9", "port": 623, "user": "admin", "lanplus": true },
                { "kind": "command", "off": "pdu off 3", "status": "pdu status 3" },
            ]})
        );
        let file = json!({ "methods": [{ "kind": "ipmi", "address": "a", "user": "u", "password": "pw" }] });
        assert_eq!(fence_body(file.clone()), file);
    }

    #[tokio::test]
    async fn node_fence_test_shows_the_power_of_each_method() {
        let (client, seen) = fake_api(|_| {
            json!({ "checked_by": "n2", "methods": [
                { "kind": "ipmi", "power": "on" },
                { "kind": "command", "power": "unknown", "error": "exit status: 2" },
            ]})
        })
        .await;
        let Cmd::Node {
            cmd: NodeCmd::FenceTest { node },
        } = Cli::try_parse_from(["oplctl", "node", "fence-test", "n1"])
            .unwrap()
            .cmd
        else {
            unreachable!()
        };
        let mut out = Vec::new();
        node_fence_test(&client, &node, false, &mut out)
            .await
            .unwrap();
        let text = String::from_utf8(out).unwrap();
        let lines: Vec<&str> = text.lines().collect();
        assert_eq!(lines[0], "checked by n2");
        assert_eq!(
            lines[2].split_whitespace().collect::<Vec<_>>(),
            ["1", "ipmi", "on", "-"]
        );
        assert_eq!(
            lines[3].split_whitespace().collect::<Vec<_>>(),
            ["2", "command", "unknown", "exit", "status:", "2"]
        );
        assert_eq!(
            *seen.lock().unwrap(),
            ["POST /api/v1/nodes/n1/fence-test HTTP/1.1"]
        );
    }

    #[test]
    fn cluster_status_shows_witnesses_and_warns() {
        let member = |name: &str, voter: bool, witness: bool| {
            json!({
                "id": format!("id-{name}"),
                "name": name,
                "address": format!("{name}:8006"),
                "cluster_address": format!("{name}:8007"),
                "voter": voter,
                "online": true,
                "witness": witness,
            })
        };
        let status = |members: Vec<Value>| {
            let view = json!({
                "name": "lab",
                "ca_fingerprint": "ab:cd",
                "leader": "id-a",
                "node": "id-a",
                "members": members,
            });
            let mut out = Vec::new();
            print_cluster_status(&mut out, &view).unwrap();
            String::from_utf8(out).unwrap()
        };
        // 일반 노드 둘과 위트니스면 투표 멤버가 셋이라 경고가 없다. 펜싱이 꺼졌으면(null) 또는 옛
        // 서버라 `fencing`이 없으면 `-`다.
        let mut a = member("a", true, false);
        a["fencing"] = json!("process");
        let mut b = member("b", true, false);
        b["fencing"] = Value::Null;
        assert_eq!(
            status(vec![a, b, member("w", true, true)]),
            "cluster: lab\nCA fingerprint: ab:cd\n\
             NAME  ID    ADDRESS  ROLE   ONLINE  LEADER  WITNESS  FENCING\n\
             a     id-a  a:8006   voter  true    true    false    process\n\
             b     id-b  b:8006   voter  true    false   false    -\n\
             w     id-w  w:8006   voter  true    false   true     -\n"
        );
        const TWO: &str = "warning: a two-node cluster";
        const HA: &str = "warning: HA needs at least two non-witness nodes";
        // 투표 멤버 둘이면 위트니스가 있어도 2노드 경고다.
        let out = status(vec![member("a", true, false), member("w", true, true)]);
        assert!(out.contains(TWO) && !out.contains(HA), "{out}");
        // 투표 멤버가 셋 이상이어도 일반 노드가 하나뿐이면 HA 경고다.
        let out = status(vec![
            member("a", true, false),
            member("w", true, true),
            member("v", true, true),
        ]);
        assert!(out.contains(HA) && !out.contains(TWO), "{out}");
        // learner는 투표 멤버로 세지 않는다.
        let out = status(vec![
            member("a", true, false),
            member("w", true, true),
            member("v", true, true),
            member("b", false, false),
        ]);
        assert!(out.contains(HA), "{out}");
        // 옛 서버는 witness를 보내지 않는다 — 모두 일반 노드로 본다.
        let mut old = member("c", true, false);
        old.as_object_mut().unwrap().remove("witness");
        let out = status(vec![
            member("a", true, false),
            member("b", true, false),
            old,
        ]);
        assert!(!out.contains("warning"), "{out}");
    }

    /// ROLE은 서버가 보낸 `role`(관찰 노드 포함)이고, `role`이 없는 옛 서버는 `voter`로 voter·learner를 가린다.
    #[test]
    fn cluster_status_shows_observers() {
        let member = |name: &str, voter: bool, role: Option<&str>| {
            let mut m = json!({
                "id": format!("id-{name}"),
                "name": name,
                "address": format!("{name}:8006"),
                "cluster_address": format!("{name}:8007"),
                "voter": voter,
                "online": true,
                "witness": false,
            });
            if let Some(role) = role {
                m["role"] = json!(role);
            }
            m
        };
        let view = json!({
            "name": "lab",
            "ca_fingerprint": "ab:cd",
            "leader": "id-a",
            "node": "id-a",
            "members": [
                member("a", true, Some("voter")),
                member("b", true, Some("voter")),
                member("c", true, Some("voter")),
                member("l", false, Some("learner")),
                member("o", false, Some("observer")),
                member("x", false, None),
            ],
        });
        let mut out = Vec::new();
        print_cluster_status(&mut out, &view).unwrap();
        let out = String::from_utf8(out).unwrap();
        assert!(out.contains("o     id-o  o:8006   observer  true"), "{out}");
        assert!(out.contains("l     id-l  l:8006   learner   true"), "{out}");
        assert!(out.contains("x     id-x  x:8006   learner   true"), "{out}");
    }

    /// 버전을 아는 멤버의 버전이 둘 이상이면 낮은 것부터 한 번씩 적어 경고한다. 모르는 멤버는 세지 않는다.
    #[test]
    fn cluster_status_warns_about_mixed_versions() {
        let member = |name: &str, version: Option<&str>| {
            json!({
                "id": format!("id-{name}"),
                "name": name,
                "address": format!("{name}:8006"),
                "cluster_address": format!("{name}:8007"),
                "voter": true,
                "online": true,
                "witness": false,
                "version": version,
            })
        };
        let status = |members: Vec<Value>| {
            let view = json!({
                "name": "lab",
                "ca_fingerprint": "ab:cd",
                "leader": "id-a",
                "node": "id-a",
                "members": members,
            });
            let mut out = Vec::new();
            print_cluster_status(&mut out, &view).unwrap();
            String::from_utf8(out).unwrap()
        };
        let out = status(vec![
            member("a", Some("0.10.0")),
            member("b", Some("0.9.0")),
            member("c", Some("0.10.0")),
            member("d", Some("0.10.0~rc1")),
            member("e", None),
        ]);
        assert!(
            out.ends_with(
                "warning: nodes run different Orbivisor versions (0.9.0, 0.10.0~rc1, 0.10.0); \
                 finish the upgrade on every node\n"
            ),
            "{out}"
        );
        let out = status(vec![
            member("a", Some("0.10.0")),
            member("b", Some("0.10.0")),
            member("c", None),
        ]);
        assert!(!out.contains("warning"), "{out}");
    }

    /// 방향과 동작은 꼭, 프로토콜·포트·CIDR은 이 차례로 생략할 수 있다.
    #[test]
    fn parses_rules() {
        assert_eq!(
            parse_rule("in accept tcp 22 10.0.0.0/8"),
            Ok(json!({
                "direction": "in", "action": "accept", "protocol": "tcp",
                "ports": "22", "remote": "10.0.0.0/8"
            }))
        );
        assert_eq!(
            parse_rule("out drop tcp 25"),
            Ok(json!({ "direction": "out", "action": "drop", "protocol": "tcp", "ports": "25" }))
        );
        assert_eq!(
            parse_rule("in accept icmp"),
            Ok(json!({ "direction": "in", "action": "accept", "protocol": "icmp" }))
        );
        assert_eq!(
            parse_rule("  in   accept udp 8000-8080 "),
            Ok(json!({
                "direction": "in", "action": "accept", "protocol": "udp", "ports": "8000-8080"
            }))
        );
        assert_eq!(
            parse_rule("out accept 2001:db8::/32"),
            Ok(json!({ "direction": "out", "action": "accept", "remote": "2001:db8::/32" }))
        );
        assert_eq!(
            parse_rule("in drop"),
            Ok(json!({ "direction": "in", "action": "drop" }))
        );
        // 포트 범위와 프로토콜·포트의 짝은 서버가 본다.
        assert_eq!(
            parse_rule("in accept 99999"),
            Ok(json!({ "direction": "in", "action": "accept", "ports": "99999" }))
        );
        for bad in [
            "",
            "in",
            "accept in",
            "up accept",
            "in allow",
            "in accept sctp",
            "in accept tcp 22 10.0.0.0/8 extra",
            "in accept 10.0.0.0/8 tcp",
            "in accept tcp 10.0.0.0/8 22",
            "in accept tcp ssh",
            "in accept tcp 22-",
            "in accept tcp -22",
            "IN accept",
        ] {
            let err = parse_rule(bad).unwrap_err();
            assert!(err.contains("in|out accept|drop"), "{bad:?}: {err}");
        }
    }

    #[test]
    fn parses_security_group_commands() {
        let parse = |args: &[&str]| {
            let mut argv = vec!["oplctl", "security-group"];
            argv.extend_from_slice(args);
            Cli::try_parse_from(argv).map(|cli| match cli.cmd {
                Cmd::SecurityGroup { cmd } => cmd,
                _ => unreachable!(),
            })
        };
        let SecurityGroupCmd::Create {
            name,
            description,
            rules,
        } = parse(&[
            "create",
            "web",
            "--description",
            "web servers",
            "--rule",
            "in accept tcp 443",
            "--rule",
            "in accept icmp",
        ])
        .unwrap()
        else {
            panic!("not create")
        };
        assert_eq!(
            security_group_create_body(&name, description.as_deref(), &rules),
            json!({ "name": "web", "spec": {
                "description": "web servers",
                "rules": [
                    { "direction": "in", "action": "accept", "protocol": "tcp", "ports": "443" },
                    { "direction": "in", "action": "accept", "protocol": "icmp" },
                ]
            }})
        );
        // 설명이 없으면 보내지 않는다. 규칙 없는 그룹도 된다.
        let SecurityGroupCmd::Create {
            name,
            description,
            rules,
        } = parse(&["create", "empty"]).unwrap()
        else {
            panic!("not create")
        };
        assert_eq!(
            security_group_create_body(&name, description.as_deref(), &rules),
            json!({ "name": "empty", "spec": { "rules": [] } })
        );
        assert!(parse(&["create", "web", "--rule", "in maybe"]).is_err());
        assert!(matches!(
            parse(&["rule", "add", "web", "out drop tcp 25", "--at", "2"]).unwrap(),
            SecurityGroupCmd::Rule { cmd: RuleCmd::Add { group, rule, at: Some(2) } }
                if group == "web" && rule["ports"] == "25"
        ));
        assert!(matches!(
            parse(&["rule", "rm", "web", "3"]).unwrap(),
            SecurityGroupCmd::Rule { cmd: RuleCmd::Rm { group, n: 3 } } if group == "web"
        ));
        assert!(parse(&["rule", "add", "web", "sideways accept"]).is_err());
        assert!(parse(&["rule", "rm", "web", "first"]).is_err());
        assert!(matches!(
            parse(&["get", "web"]).unwrap(),
            SecurityGroupCmd::Get { group } if group == "web"
        ));
        assert!(matches!(
            parse(&["delete", "web"]).unwrap(),
            SecurityGroupCmd::Delete { group } if group == "web"
        ));
    }

    /// 규칙 번호는 1부터다. 범위 밖이면 아무것도 바꾸지 않고 실패한다.
    #[test]
    fn adds_and_removes_rules_by_number() {
        let rule =
            |n: u16| json!({ "direction": "in", "action": "accept", "ports": n.to_string() });
        let group = json!({ "name": "web", "spec": { "rules": [rule(1), rule(2)] } });
        assert_eq!(
            rules_with(&group, rule(9), None).unwrap(),
            vec![rule(1), rule(2), rule(9)]
        );
        assert_eq!(
            rules_with(&group, rule(9), Some(1)).unwrap(),
            vec![rule(9), rule(1), rule(2)]
        );
        assert_eq!(
            rules_with(&group, rule(9), Some(3)).unwrap(),
            vec![rule(1), rule(2), rule(9)]
        );
        for at in [0, 4] {
            let err = rules_with(&group, rule(9), Some(at))
                .unwrap_err()
                .to_string();
            assert!(err.contains("use 1 to 3"), "{err}");
        }
        assert_eq!(rules_without(&group, 1).unwrap(), vec![rule(2)]);
        assert_eq!(rules_without(&group, 2).unwrap(), vec![rule(1)]);
        for n in [0, 3] {
            let err = rules_without(&group, n).unwrap_err().to_string();
            assert!(err.contains(&format!("has no rule {n}")), "{err}");
        }
        // 규칙이 없는 그룹은 응답에 rules가 비어 있다.
        let empty = json!({ "name": "e", "spec": { "rules": [] } });
        assert_eq!(rules_with(&empty, rule(1), None).unwrap(), vec![rule(1)]);
        assert!(rules_without(&empty, 1).is_err());
    }

    /// `--nic NETWORK[,sg=A+B]`. 그룹이 없으면 `security_groups`를 보내지 않는다.
    #[test]
    fn parses_nics_with_security_groups() {
        let nics = |args: &[&str]| {
            let mut argv = vec!["oplctl", "vm", "create", "web"];
            argv.extend_from_slice(args);
            Cli::try_parse_from(argv).map(|cli| match cli.cmd {
                Cmd::Vm {
                    cmd: VmCmd::Create(c),
                } => c.nics.iter().map(nic_body).collect::<Vec<_>>(),
                _ => unreachable!(),
            })
        };
        assert_eq!(
            nics(&[
                "--nic",
                "user",
                "--nic",
                "lan,sg=web+db",
                "--nic",
                "dmz,sg=web"
            ])
            .unwrap(),
            vec![
                json!({ "network": "user", "model": "virtio" }),
                json!({ "network": "lan", "model": "virtio", "security_groups": ["web", "db"] }),
                json!({ "network": "dmz", "model": "virtio", "security_groups": ["web"] }),
            ]
        );
        for bad in [
            "",
            ",sg=web",
            "lan,",
            "lan,sg=",
            "lan,sg=web+",
            "lan,sg=+web",
            "lan,group=web",
            "lan,sg=web,sg=db",
        ] {
            assert!(nics(&["--nic", bad]).is_err(), "{bad:?}");
        }
    }

    #[test]
    fn parses_vm_nic_sg() {
        let cli = Cli::try_parse_from(["oplctl", "vm", "nic-sg", "web", "1", "a", "b"]).unwrap();
        assert!(matches!(
            cli.cmd,
            Cmd::Vm { cmd: VmCmd::NicSg { vm, index: 1, groups } }
                if vm == "web" && groups == ["a", "b"]
        ));
        let cli = Cli::try_parse_from(["oplctl", "vm", "nic-sg", "web", "0"]).unwrap();
        assert!(matches!(
            cli.cmd,
            Cmd::Vm { cmd: VmCmd::NicSg { index: 0, groups, .. } } if groups.is_empty()
        ));
        assert!(Cli::try_parse_from(["oplctl", "vm", "nic-sg", "web"]).is_err());
        assert!(Cli::try_parse_from(["oplctl", "vm", "nic-sg", "web", "-1"]).is_err());
    }

    /// 그 NIC의 그룹만 바꾸고 나머지(다른 NIC, 다른 필드, 라벨)는 그대로 둔다.
    #[test]
    fn nic_groups_update_changes_one_nic() {
        let vm = json!({
            "name": "web",
            "revision": 4,
            "labels": { "team": "a" },
            "spec": {
                "memory_mib": 256,
                "nics": [
                    { "network": "user", "model": "virtio" },
                    { "network": "lan", "model": "virtio", "mac": "52:54:00:00:00:01", "security_groups": ["old"] },
                ],
            },
        });
        let groups = ["web".to_string(), "db".to_string()];
        assert_eq!(
            nic_groups_update(&vm, 1, &groups).unwrap(),
            json!({ "labels": { "team": "a" }, "spec": {
                "memory_mib": 256,
                "nics": [
                    { "network": "user", "model": "virtio" },
                    { "network": "lan", "model": "virtio", "mac": "52:54:00:00:00:01", "security_groups": ["web", "db"] },
                ],
            }})
        );
        assert_eq!(
            nic_groups_update(&vm, 1, &[]).unwrap()["spec"]["nics"][1]["security_groups"],
            json!([])
        );
        let err = nic_groups_update(&vm, 2, &groups).unwrap_err().to_string();
        assert_eq!(err, "VM web has no NIC 2 (2 NICs, numbered from 0)");
    }

    /// `import` 명령의 인자
    fn parse_import(args: &[&str]) -> Result<ImportCmd, clap::Error> {
        let mut argv = vec!["oplctl", "import"];
        argv.extend_from_slice(args);
        Cli::try_parse_from(argv).map(|cli| match cli.cmd {
            Cmd::Import { cmd } => cmd,
            _ => unreachable!(),
        })
    }

    /// `import run`의 인자를 요청 본문으로. `sources`는 가져오기의 원본 네트워크다.
    fn import_run(args: &[&str], sources: &[&str]) -> anyhow::Result<Value> {
        let mut argv = vec!["run", "web01"];
        argv.extend_from_slice(args);
        let ImportCmd::Run(run) = parse_import(&argv)? else {
            unreachable!()
        };
        let sources: Vec<String> = sources.iter().map(|s| s.to_string()).collect();
        import_run_body(&run, &sources)
    }

    #[test]
    fn parses_import_commands() {
        assert!(matches!(
            parse_import(&["ova", "/tmp/web01.ova", "--name", "web01"]).unwrap(),
            ImportCmd::Ova { file, name } if file == std::path::Path::new("/tmp/web01.ova") && name == "web01"
        ));
        assert!(matches!(parse_import(&["list"]).unwrap(), ImportCmd::List));
        assert!(matches!(
            parse_import(&["get", "web01"]).unwrap(),
            ImportCmd::Get { import } if import == "web01"
        ));
        assert!(matches!(
            parse_import(&["delete", "web01", "--force"]).unwrap(),
            ImportCmd::Delete { import, force: true } if import == "web01"
        ));
        // 가져오기 이름, 새 VM 이름과 풀은 꼭 준다.
        for args in [
            &["ova", "/tmp/web01.ova"][..],
            &["run", "web01", "--pool", "local"],
            &["run", "web01", "--name", "web"],
            &[
                "run",
                "web01",
                "--name",
                "web",
                "--pool",
                "local",
                "--disk-bus",
                "ide",
            ],
            &[
                "run",
                "web01",
                "--name",
                "web",
                "--pool",
                "local",
                "--net",
                "VM Network=",
            ],
            &[
                "run", "web01", "--name", "web", "--pool", "local", "--net", "=lan",
            ],
            &[
                "run", "web01", "--name", "web", "--pool", "local", "--net", "",
            ],
        ] {
            assert!(parse_import(args).is_err(), "{args:?}");
        }
    }

    #[test]
    fn import_run_builds_the_body() {
        // 주지 않은 값은 비워 두어 서버가 제안 값을 쓴다.
        assert_eq!(
            import_run(
                &[
                    "--name",
                    "web",
                    "--pool",
                    "local",
                    "--net",
                    "VM Network=lan",
                    "--net",
                    "DMZ=dmz",
                    "--net",
                    "a=b=lan"
                ],
                &["DMZ", "VM Network", "a=b"]
            )
            .unwrap(),
            json!({
                "name": "web", "pool": "local",
                "networks": { "VM Network": "lan", "DMZ": "dmz", "a=b": "lan" },
                "disk_bus": null, "nic_model": null, "firmware": null,
                "sockets": null, "cores": null, "memory_mib": null,
                "keep_macs": true
            })
        );
        assert_eq!(
            import_run(
                &[
                    "--name",
                    "web",
                    "--pool",
                    "local",
                    "--net",
                    "lan",
                    "--disk-bus",
                    "sata",
                    "--nic-model",
                    "e1000e",
                    "--firmware",
                    "bios",
                    "--sockets",
                    "2",
                    "--cores",
                    "4",
                    "--memory",
                    "8192",
                    "--new-macs"
                ],
                &["VM Network"]
            )
            .unwrap(),
            json!({
                "name": "web", "pool": "local",
                "networks": { "VM Network": "lan" },
                "disk_bus": "sata", "nic_model": "e1000e", "firmware": "bios",
                "sockets": 2, "cores": 4, "memory_mib": 8192,
                "keep_macs": false
            })
        );
        assert_eq!(
            import_run(
                &["--name", "web", "--pool", "p", "--disk-bus", "virtio-blk"],
                &[]
            )
            .unwrap()["disk_bus"],
            "virtio-blk"
        );
        // `=` 없는 --net은 원본 네트워크가 하나일 때만 쓴다.
        let err = import_run(
            &["--name", "web", "--pool", "p", "--net", "lan"],
            &["A", "B"],
        );
        assert_eq!(
            err.unwrap_err().to_string(),
            "--net lan needs SOURCE=NETWORK: vm-import web01 has 2 source networks (\"A\", \"B\")"
        );
        let err = import_run(&["--name", "web", "--pool", "p", "--net", "lan"], &[]);
        assert_eq!(
            err.unwrap_err().to_string(),
            "--net lan needs SOURCE=NETWORK: vm-import web01 has 0 source networks ()"
        );
    }

    fn sample_import() -> Value {
        json!({
            "id": "11111111-1111-1111-1111-111111111111",

    #[test]
    fn source_networks_are_the_proposal_keys() {
        assert_eq!(source_networks(&sample_import()), ["DMZ", "VM Network"]);
        assert!(source_networks(&json!({ "status": {} })).is_empty());
    }

    #[test]
    fn import_list_shows_node_source_and_vm_names() {
        let nodes = [json!({ "id": "n-1", "name": "node1" })];
        let vms = [json!({ "id": "v-1", "name": "web" })];
        assert_eq!(
            import_row(&sample_import(), &nodes, &vms),
            ["web01", "node1", "web01-src", "ready", "-"]
        );
        // 만든 VM은 이름으로, 지운 VM·빠진 노드는 id로 보인다.
        let mut done = sample_import();
        done["status"]["phase"] = json!("done");
        done["status"]["vm"] = json!("v-1");
        assert_eq!(import_row(&done, &nodes, &vms)[3..], ["done", "web"]);
        assert_eq!(
            import_row(&done, &[], &[])[1..],
            ["n-1", "web01-src", "done", "v-1"]
        );
        // 원본을 읽지 못한 가져오기는 파일 이름을 보인다.
        let mut failed = sample_import();
        failed["status"] = json!({ "phase": "failed" });
        assert_eq!(import_row(&failed, &nodes, &vms)[2], "web01.ova");
    }

    #[test]
    fn import_get_shows_the_source_proposal_and_warnings() {
        let nodes = [json!({ "id": "n-1", "name": "node1" })];
        let mut out = Vec::new();
        print_import(&mut out, &sample_import(), &nodes, &[]).unwrap();
        assert_eq!(
            String::from_utf8(out).unwrap(),
            "\
vm-import: web01
node: node1
source: web01.ova (1.5GiB)
phase: ready
error: checksum mismatch for web01-disk1.vmdk
source vm: web01-src (otherLinux64Guest, uefi, 2 vCPUs, 2 cores per socket, 1024 MiB)
proposal: 1 sockets x 2 cores, 1024 MiB, uefi, virtio-blk disks, virtio NICs

DISK   FILE              SIZE     CONTROLLER
disk0  web01-disk1.vmdk  10.0GiB  scsi

NETWORK     ADAPTER  MAC                PROPOSED
VM Network  vmxnet3  00:50:56:aa:bb:cc  VM Network
DMZ         e1000    -                  -

warnings:
  first warning
  second warning
"
        );
        // 끝난 가져오기는 만든 VM을, 경고가 없으면 경고 줄을 뺀다.
        let mut done = sample_import();
        done["status"]["phase"] = json!("done");
        done["status"]["vm"] = json!("v-1");
        done["status"]["warnings"] = json!([]);
        done["status"]["error"] = Value::Null;
        let mut out = Vec::new();
        print_import(
            &mut out,
            &done,
            &nodes,
            &[json!({ "id": "v-1", "name": "web" })],
        )
        .unwrap();
        let text = String::from_utf8(out).unwrap();
        assert!(text.contains("phase: done\nvm: web\nsource vm: "), "{text}");
        assert!(
            !text.contains("warnings") && !text.contains("error"),
            "{text}"
        );
    }

    /// `import ova`는 크기로 먼저 확인하고 실제 파일 이름과 함께 올린다.
    #[tokio::test]
    async fn import_ova_checks_then_uploads_with_the_file_name() {
        let dir = tempfile::tempdir().unwrap();
        // 본문이 없어야 작은 시험 서버가 요청 줄만 읽고 답할 수 있다.
        let file = dir.path().join("web01-export.ova");
        std::fs::write(&file, b"").unwrap();
        let (client, seen) = fake_api(|_| json!({ "name": "web01" })).await;
        let cmd = ImportCmd::Ova {
            file,
            name: "web01".into(),
        };
        let mut out = Vec::new();
        import(&client, cmd, false, &mut out).await.unwrap();
        assert_eq!(
            *seen.lock().unwrap(),
            [
                "POST /api/v1/vm-imports/ova/check?name=web01&size=0 HTTP/1.1",
                "POST /api/v1/vm-imports/ova?name=web01&file_name=web01-export.ova HTTP/1.1"
            ]
        );
        assert_eq!(
            String::from_utf8(out).unwrap(),
            "vm-import web01 uploaded; review it with `orbivisorctl import get web01`\n"
        );
    }

    /// `=` 없는 `--net`이면 가져오기를 읽어 원본 네트워크를 찾고, 실행 Task를 기다린다.
    #[tokio::test]
    async fn import_run_reads_the_import_for_a_bare_net_and_waits() {
        let (client, seen) = fake_api(|path| {
            if path.starts_with("/api/v1/tasks/") {
                json!({ "id": "t1", "status": { "state": "succeeded" } })
            } else if path.ends_with("/run") {
                json!({ "id": "t1", "spec": {}, "status": { "state": "pending" } })
            } else {
                json!({ "status": { "proposal": { "networks": { "VM Network": null } } } })
            }
        })
        .await;
        let run = |args: &[&str]| {
            let mut argv = vec![
                "oplctl", "import", "run", "web01", "--name", "web", "--pool", "p",
            ];
            argv.extend_from_slice(args);
            match Cli::try_parse_from(argv).unwrap().cmd {
                Cmd::Import { cmd } => cmd,
                _ => unreachable!(),
            }
        };
        let mut out = Vec::new();
        import(&client, run(&["--net", "lan"]), false, &mut out)
            .await
            .unwrap();
        // SOURCE=NETWORK만 주면 읽지 않는다.
        import(&client, run(&["--net", "VM Network=lan"]), false, &mut out)
            .await
            .unwrap();
        assert_eq!(
            *seen.lock().unwrap(),
            [
                "GET /api/v1/vm-imports/web01 HTTP/1.1",
                "POST /api/v1/vm-imports/web01/run HTTP/1.1",
                "GET /api/v1/tasks/t1 HTTP/1.1",
                "POST /api/v1/vm-imports/web01/run HTTP/1.1",
                "GET /api/v1/tasks/t1 HTTP/1.1"
            ]
        );
        assert_eq!(
            String::from_utf8(out).unwrap(),
            "vm web imported\nvm web imported\n"
        );
    }

    /// `import delete --force`는 `?force=true`로 보내고 서버의 알림을 보인다. 아니면 Task를 기다린다.
    #[tokio::test]
    async fn import_delete_force_shows_the_server_message() {
        let (client, seen) = fake_api(|_| {
            json!({ "message": "vm-import \"web01\" deleted; its files are left on node \"n1\" (x)" })
        })
        .await;
        let mut out = Vec::new();
        let cmd = ImportCmd::Delete {
            import: "web01".into(),
            force: true,
        };
        import(&client, cmd, false, &mut out).await.unwrap();
        assert_eq!(
            *seen.lock().unwrap(),
            ["DELETE /api/v1/vm-imports/web01?force=true HTTP/1.1"]
        );
        assert_eq!(
            String::from_utf8(out).unwrap(),
            "vm-import \"web01\" deleted; its files are left on node \"n1\" (x)\n"
        );

        let (client, seen) = fake_api(|path| {
            if path.starts_with("/api/v1/tasks/") {
                json!({ "id": "t1", "status": { "state": "succeeded" } })
            } else {
                json!({ "id": "t1", "spec": {}, "status": { "state": "pending" } })
            }
        })
        .await;
        let mut out = Vec::new();
        let cmd = ImportCmd::Delete {
            import: "web01".into(),
            force: false,
        };
        import(&client, cmd, false, &mut out).await.unwrap();
        assert_eq!(
            *seen.lock().unwrap(),
            [
                "DELETE /api/v1/vm-imports/web01 HTTP/1.1",
                "GET /api/v1/tasks/t1 HTTP/1.1"
            ]
        );
        assert_eq!(String::from_utf8(out).unwrap(), "vm-import web01 deleted\n");
    }

    #[test]
    fn parses_import_esxi_commands() {
        let ImportCmd::EsxiBrowse { conn, fingerprint } =
            parse_import(&["esxi-browse", "--host", "esx1", "--user", "root"]).unwrap()
        else {
            unreachable!()
        };
        assert_eq!(fingerprint, None);
        // 포트와 데이터센터는 ESXi 기본값이다.
        assert_eq!(
            esxi_connection(&conn, fingerprint.as_deref(), "secret"),
            json!({
                "host": "esx1", "port": 443, "user": "root", "password": "secret",
                "datacenter": "ha-datacenter", "fingerprint": null
            })
        );
        let ImportCmd::Esxi {
            name,
            conn,
            fingerprint,
            datastore,
            vmx,
        } = parse_import(&[
            "esxi",
            "web01",
            "--host",
            "vc1",
            "--port",
            "8443",
            "--user",
            "admin@vsphere.local",
            "--datacenter",
            "DC1",
            "--datastore",
            "datastore1",
            "--vmx",
            "web01/web01.vmx",
            "--fingerprint",
            "AB:CD",
        ])
        .unwrap()
        else {
            unreachable!()
        };
        assert_eq!(
            esxi_import_body(
                &name,
                &esxi_connection(&conn, Some(&fingerprint), "pw"),
                &datastore,
                &vmx
            ),
            json!({
                "name": "web01",
                "connection": {
                    "host": "vc1", "port": 8443, "user": "admin@vsphere.local", "password": "pw",
                    "datacenter": "DC1", "fingerprint": "AB:CD"
                },
                "datastore": "datastore1",
                "vmx": "web01/web01.vmx"
            })
        );
        // 만들기에는 지문·데이터스토어·.vmx가 꼭 있어야 하고, 비밀번호는 인자로 받지 않는다.
        let full = [
            "esxi",
            "web01",
            "--host",
            "esx1",
            "--user",
            "root",
            "--datastore",
            "ds",
            "--vmx",
            "a/a.vmx",
            "--fingerprint",
            "AB",
        ];
        assert!(parse_import(&full).is_ok());
        for skip in ["--datastore", "--vmx", "--fingerprint", "--host", "--user"] {
            let i = full.iter().position(|a| *a == skip).unwrap();
            let args: Vec<&str> = full[..i].iter().chain(&full[i + 2..]).copied().collect();
            assert!(parse_import(&args).is_err(), "{args:?}");
        }
        let mut with_password = full.to_vec();
        with_password.extend(["--password", "x"]);
        assert!(parse_import(&with_password).is_err());
        assert!(parse_import(&["esxi-browse", "--host", "esx1"]).is_err());

        // 비밀번호 파일(끝의 줄바꿈은 뺀다)
        let dir = tempfile::tempdir().unwrap();
        let file = dir.path().join("esxi-password");
        std::fs::write(&file, "VMware1!\n").unwrap();
        let mut with_file = full.to_vec();
        with_file.extend(["--password-file", file.to_str().unwrap()]);
        let ImportCmd::Esxi { conn, .. } = parse_import(&with_file).unwrap() else {
            unreachable!()
        };
        assert_eq!(esxi_password(&conn).unwrap(), "VMware1!");
    }

    fn sample_browse() -> Value {
        json!({
            "datastores": [
                {
                    "name": "datastore1",
                    "vms": [
                        {
                            "vmx": "web01/web01.vmx", "name": "web01", "guest_os": "ubuntu-64",
                            "vcpus": 2, "memory_mib": 1024, "disks": 1, "locked": false, "error": null
                        },
                        {
                            "vmx": "db/db.vmx", "name": "db", "guest_os": "", "vcpus": 0,
                            "memory_mib": 0, "disks": 0, "locked": true,
                            "error": "memsize is missing"
                        }
                    ]
                },
                { "name": "empty", "vms": [] }
            ]
        })
    }

    /// `import esxi-browse`는 연결을 보내고 데이터스토어의 VM을 표로 보인다. 읽지 못한 VM은 NAME
    /// 자리에 오류를 보인다.
    #[tokio::test]
    async fn import_esxi_browse_shows_the_vms() {
        let (client, seen) = fake_api(|_| sample_browse()).await;
        let mut out = Vec::new();
        let conn = json!({ "host": "esx1" });
        esxi_browse(&client, &conn, false, &mut out).await.unwrap();
        assert_eq!(
            *seen.lock().unwrap(),
            ["POST /api/v1/vm-imports/esxi/browse HTTP/1.1"]
        );
        assert_eq!(
            String::from_utf8(out).unwrap(),
            "\
DATASTORE   VMX              NAME                       GUEST      CPU  MEMORY  DISKS  LOCKED
datastore1  web01/web01.vmx  web01                      ubuntu-64  2    1.0GiB  1      false
datastore1  db/db.vmx        error: memsize is missing  -          -    -       -      true
"
        );
        // --json이면 응답 그대로
        let mut out = Vec::new();
        esxi_browse(&client, &conn, true, &mut out).await.unwrap();
        let printed: Value = serde_json::from_slice(&out).unwrap();
        assert_eq!(printed, sample_browse());
    }

    /// 지문을 주지 않았거나(409 `untrusted_certificate`) 틀리면 서버 인증서의 지문으로 다시 하라고 알린다.
    #[tokio::test]
    async fn import_esxi_explains_an_untrusted_certificate() {
        let (client, _) = fake_api_status(|_| {
            (
                409,
                json!({
                    "code": "untrusted_certificate",
                    "message": "verify the ESXi certificate fingerprint",
                    "details": { "fingerprint": "AB:CD:EF" }
                }),
            )
        })
        .await;
        let conn = json!({ "host": "esx1" });
        let err = esxi_browse(&client, &conn, false, &mut Vec::new())
            .await
            .unwrap_err();
        assert_eq!(
            err.to_string(),
            "the ESXi certificate fingerprint is AB:CD:EF; check it and rerun with --fingerprint AB:CD:EF"
        );
        let body = esxi_import_body("web01", &conn, "ds", "a/a.vmx");
        let err = esxi_create(&client, &body, &mut Vec::new())
            .await
            .unwrap_err();
        assert_eq!(
            err.to_string(),
            "the ESXi certificate fingerprint is AB:CD:EF; check it and rerun with --fingerprint AB:CD:EF"
        );
        // 다른 오류는 서버의 메시지와 코드 그대로
        let (client, _) = fake_api_status(|_| {
            (
                400,
                json!({ "code": "esxi_auth", "message": "ESXi rejected the user name or password" }),
            )
        })
        .await;
        let err = esxi_browse(&client, &conn, false, &mut Vec::new())
            .await
            .unwrap_err();
        assert_eq!(
            err.to_string(),
            "ESXi rejected the user name or password (esxi_auth)"
        );
    }

    /// `import esxi`는 가져오기를 만들고 검토 명령을 알린다.

    /// `node updates`는 확인 시각, 오류, 패키지 표, 잘렸는지를 보인다. `--refresh`면 다시 확인 Task를
    /// 기다린 뒤 읽는다.
    #[tokio::test]
    async fn node_updates_shows_the_check() {
        fn reply(path: &str) -> Value {
            match path {
                "/api/v1/nodes/n1/updates/refresh" => json!({ "id": "t1" }),
                "/api/v1/tasks/t1" => json!({ "id": "t1", "status": { "state": "succeeded" } }),
                "/api/v1/nodes/n1" => json!({
                    "name": "n1",
                    "status": { "updates": {
                        "checked_at": 1_793_000_000,
                        "packages": [
                            { "name": "orbivisor", "current": "0.2.0", "candidate": "0.2.1" },
                            { "name": "linux-image-6.12.48+deb13-amd64", "current": null, "candidate": "6.12.48-1" }
                        ],
                        "truncated": true,
                        "error": null
                    } }
                }),
                "/api/v1/nodes/n2" => json!({
                    "name": "n2",
                    "status": { "updates": {
                        "checked_at": 1_793_000_000, "packages": [],
                        "error": "apt-get update -q failed (exit status: 100): E: no network"
                    } }
                }),
                "/api/v1/nodes/n3" => json!({
                    "name": "n3",
                    "status": { "updates": { "checked_at": 1_793_000_000, "packages": [], "error": null } }
                }),
                "/api/v1/nodes/n4" => json!({
                    "name": "n4",
                    "status": { "updates": { "checked_at": null, "packages": [], "error": null } }
                }),
                _ => json!({ "name": "w", "status": { "online": true } }),
            }
        }
        let (client, seen) = fake_api(reply).await;
        let run = |args: &'static [&'static str], json_out: bool| {
            let client = client.clone();
            async move {
                let Cmd::Node {
                    cmd: NodeCmd::Updates { node, refresh },
                } = Cli::try_parse_from(args).unwrap().cmd
                else {
                    unreachable!()
                };
                let mut out = Vec::new();
                node_updates(&client, &node, refresh, json_out, &mut out)
                    .await
                    .map(|()| String::from_utf8(out).unwrap())
            }
        };

        let text = run(&["oplctl", "node", "updates", "n1", "--refresh"], false)
            .await
            .unwrap();
        assert_eq!(
            text,
            "checked: 2026-10-26 07:33 UTC\n\
             PACKAGE                          CURRENT  CANDIDATE\n\
             orbivisor                        0.2.0    0.2.1\n\
             linux-image-6.12.48+deb13-amd64  -        6.12.48-1\n\
             (only the first 2 packages are shown)\n"
        );
        assert_eq!(
            *seen.lock().unwrap(),
            [
                "POST /api/v1/nodes/n1/updates/refresh HTTP/1.1",
                "GET /api/v1/tasks/t1 HTTP/1.1",
                "GET /api/v1/nodes/n1 HTTP/1.1"
            ]
        );
        assert_eq!(
            run(&["oplctl", "node", "updates", "n2"], false)
                .await
                .unwrap(),
            "checked: 2026-10-26 07:33 UTC\n\
             error: apt-get update -q failed (exit status: 100): E: no network\n"
        );
        assert_eq!(
            run(&["oplctl", "node", "updates", "n3"], false)
                .await
                .unwrap(),
            "checked: 2026-10-26 07:33 UTC\nno updates available\n"
        );
        assert_eq!(
            run(&["oplctl", "node", "updates", "n4"], false)
                .await
                .unwrap(),
            "checked: never\n"
        );
        let err = run(&["oplctl", "node", "updates", "w"], false)
            .await
            .unwrap_err();
        assert_eq!(err.to_string(), "node w does not check for updates");
        let shown: Value = serde_json::from_str(
            &run(&["oplctl", "node", "updates", "n3"], true)
                .await
                .unwrap(),
        )
        .unwrap();
        assert_eq!(shown["packages"], json!([]));
    }

    /// `node upgrade`는 업그레이드 Task를 만들고 따라가는 방법을 알린다. `--wait`이면 Task를 기다린다.
    #[tokio::test]
    async fn node_upgrade_starts_the_task() {
        let (client, seen) = fake_api(|path| match path {
            "/api/v1/nodes/n1/upgrade" => json!({ "id": "t1" }),
            _ => json!({ "id": "t1", "status": { "state": "succeeded" } }),
        })
        .await;
        let run = |args: &'static [&'static str]| {
            let client = client.clone();
            async move {
                let Cmd::Node {
                    cmd: NodeCmd::Upgrade { node, wait },
                } = Cli::try_parse_from(args).unwrap().cmd
                else {
                    unreachable!()
                };
                let mut out = Vec::new();
                node_upgrade(&client, &node, wait, &mut out).await.unwrap();
                String::from_utf8(out).unwrap()
            }
        };

        assert_eq!(
            run(&["oplctl", "node", "upgrade", "n1"]).await,
            "upgrade of n1 started (task t1); follow it with `orbivisorctl task get t1`\n"
        );
        assert_eq!(
            *seen.lock().unwrap(),
            ["POST /api/v1/nodes/n1/upgrade HTTP/1.1"]
        );
        seen.lock().unwrap().clear();
        assert_eq!(
            run(&["oplctl", "node", "upgrade", "n1", "--wait"]).await,
            "node n1 upgraded\n"
        );
        assert_eq!(
            *seen.lock().unwrap(),
            [
                "POST /api/v1/nodes/n1/upgrade HTTP/1.1",
                "GET /api/v1/tasks/t1 HTTP/1.1"
            ]
        );
    }

    /// `node maintenance`는 on·off만 받는다. 노드를 읽어 라벨과 spec은 그대로 두고 `maintenance`만 바꿔
    /// 읽은 revision으로(`If-Match`) 다시 쓴다.
    #[tokio::test]
    async fn node_maintenance_puts_the_spec() {
        let run = |args: &'static [&'static str], base: String| async move {
            let Cmd::Node {
                cmd: NodeCmd::Maintenance { node, state },
            } = Cli::try_parse_from(args).unwrap().cmd
            else {
                unreachable!()
            };
            let client = Client::new(&base, None, None).unwrap();
            let mut out = Vec::new();
            let mut err = Vec::new();
            node_maintenance(&client, &node, state == Switch::On, &mut out, &mut err)
                .await
                .unwrap();
            assert!(err.is_empty(), "{}", String::from_utf8_lossy(&err));
            String::from_utf8(out).unwrap()
        };
        for args in [
            &["oplctl", "node", "maintenance", "n1"][..],
            &["oplctl", "node", "maintenance", "n1", "yes"][..],
        ] {
            assert!(Cli::try_parse_from(args).is_err(), "{args:?}");
        }

        let (base, seen) = fake_api_bodies(|_| {
            json!({
                "name": "n1",
                "revision": 7,
                "labels": { "rack": "a" },
                "spec": { "address": "10.0.0.1:7443", "maintenance": false, "witness": false },
                "status": { "online": true }
            })
        })
        .await;
        assert_eq!(
            run(&["oplctl", "node", "maintenance", "n1", "on"], base.clone()).await,
            "node n1: maintenance on\n"
        );
        {
            let seen = seen.lock().unwrap();
            assert_eq!(seen.len(), 2, "{seen:?}");
            assert_eq!(seen[0].line, "GET /api/v1/nodes/n1 HTTP/1.1");
            assert_eq!(seen[1].line, "PUT /api/v1/nodes/n1 HTTP/1.1");
            assert_eq!(seen[1].if_match.as_deref(), Some("7"));
            assert_eq!(
                seen[1].body,
                json!({
                    "labels": { "rack": "a" },
                    "spec": { "address": "10.0.0.1:7443", "maintenance": true, "witness": false }
                })
            );
        }
        seen.lock().unwrap().clear();
        assert_eq!(
            run(&["oplctl", "node", "maintenance", "n1", "off"], base).await,
            "node n1: maintenance off\n"
        );
        let seen = seen.lock().unwrap();
        assert_eq!(seen[1].body["spec"]["maintenance"], false);
        // 끄면 그 노드의 비우기 Task를 찾아본다(없으면 경고하지 않는다).
        assert_eq!(seen[2].line, "GET /api/v1/tasks HTTP/1.1");
    }

    /// `node roles`는 api·none·default만 받고, 노드의 spec에서 `roles`만 바꿔(default는 null) 다시 쓴다.
    #[tokio::test]
    async fn node_roles_puts_the_spec() {
        assert!(roles_value("observer").is_err());
        let (base, seen) = fake_api_bodies(|_| {
            json!({
                "name": "n1",
                "revision": 3,
                "spec": { "address": "10.0.0.1:7443", "maintenance": false, "witness": false },
                "status": { "online": true }
            })
        })
        .await;
        let client = Client::new(&base, None, None).unwrap();
        for (arg, want) in [
            ("none", json!([])),
            ("api", json!(["api"])),
            ("default", Value::Null),
        ] {
            seen.lock().unwrap().clear();
            let Cmd::Node {
                cmd: NodeCmd::Roles { node, roles },
            } = Cli::try_parse_from(["oplctl", "node", "roles", "n1", arg])
                .unwrap()
                .cmd
            else {
                unreachable!()
            };
            let mut out = Vec::new();
            node_roles(&client, &node, &roles, &mut out).await.unwrap();
            assert_eq!(
                String::from_utf8(out).unwrap(),
                format!("node n1: roles {arg}\n")
            );
            let seen = seen.lock().unwrap();
            assert_eq!(seen[1].line, "PUT /api/v1/nodes/n1 HTTP/1.1");
            assert_eq!(seen[1].if_match.as_deref(), Some("3"));
            assert_eq!(
                seen[1].body,
                json!({
                    "labels": {},
                    "spec": {
                        "address": "10.0.0.1:7443", "maintenance": false, "witness": false,
                        "roles": want
                    }
                }),
                "{arg}"
            );
        }
        let err = node_roles(&client, "n1", "web", &mut Vec::new())
            .await
            .unwrap_err();
        assert!(
            err.to_string().contains("use api, none or default"),
            "{err}"
        );
    }

    /// `cluster api-endpoints`는 표, JSON, HAProxy `server` 줄로 찍는다. `-o haproxy`는 이 명령에만 쓴다.
    #[tokio::test]
    async fn api_endpoints_print_a_table_json_or_haproxy_servers() {
        let (client, seen) = fake_api(|_| {
            json!({ "items": [
                { "name": "n1", "address": "10.0.0.1:8006", "zone": "rack-a" },
                { "name": "n2", "address": "[fd00::2]:8006", "zone": null },
            ] })
        })
        .await;
        let print = |output: Output| {
            let client = client.clone();
            async move {
                let mut out = Vec::new();
                cluster(&client, ClusterCmd::ApiEndpoints, output, &mut out)
                    .await
                    .unwrap();
                String::from_utf8(out).unwrap()
            }
        };
        assert_eq!(
            print(Output::Table).await,
            "NAME  ADDRESS         ZONE\n\
             n1    10.0.0.1:8006   rack-a\n\
             n2    [fd00::2]:8006  -\n"
        );
        let json: Value = serde_json::from_str(&print(Output::Json).await).unwrap();
        assert_eq!(json[1]["address"], "[fd00::2]:8006");
        assert_eq!(
            print(Output::Haproxy).await,
            "server n1 10.0.0.1:8006 check ssl verify required ca-file /etc/haproxy/orbivisor-ca.pem\n\
             server n2 [fd00::2]:8006 check ssl verify required ca-file /etc/haproxy/orbivisor-ca.pem\n"
        );
        assert!(
            seen.lock()
                .unwrap()
                .iter()
                .all(|l| l == "GET /api/v1/cluster/api-endpoints HTTP/1.1")
        );
        let err = run(["oplctl", "-o", "haproxy", "node", "list"], &mut Vec::new())
            .await
            .unwrap_err();
        assert!(err.to_string().contains("only for"), "{err}");
    }

    /// `GET /cluster`가 실패해도 `node list`는 목록을 보이고 VOTER는 `-`다.

            } else {
                (

                    }] }),
                )
            }
        })
        .await;
        let mut out = Vec::new();

        let text = String::from_utf8(out).unwrap();

    /// 유지보수를 끄면 그 노드의 끝나지 않은 비우기가 멈춘다고 stderr에 알린다.
    #[tokio::test]
    async fn node_maintenance_off_warns_about_a_running_drain() {
        let (base, _) = fake_api_bodies(|path| {
            if path == "/api/v1/tasks" {
                let drain = |id: &str, node: &str, state: &str| {
                    json!({
                        "id": id,
                        "spec": { "op": { "kind": "node-drain" }, "target": node, "node": node },
                        "status": { "state": state }
                    })
                };
                json!({ "items": [
                    drain("t1", "id-1", "failed"),
                    drain("t2", "id-2", "running"),
                    drain("t3", "id-1", "running"),
                ] })
            } else {
                json!({
                    "id": "id-1",
                    "name": "n1",
                    "revision": 7,
                    "spec": { "address": "10.0.0.1:7443", "maintenance": true, "witness": false },
                    "status": { "online": true }
                })
            }
        })
        .await;
        let client = Client::new(&base, None, None).unwrap();
        let mut out = Vec::new();
        let mut err = Vec::new();
        node_maintenance(&client, "n1", false, &mut out, &mut err)
            .await
            .unwrap();
        assert_eq!(
            String::from_utf8(out).unwrap(),
            "node n1: maintenance off\n"
        );
        assert_eq!(
            String::from_utf8(err).unwrap(),
            "warning: the running drain of n1 stops (task t3)\n"
        );
    }

    /// 유지보수는 이미 꺼졌으므로, 비우기 Task를 찾아보지 못해도 경고만 하고 성공한다.
    #[tokio::test]
    async fn node_maintenance_off_succeeds_when_tasks_cannot_be_read() {
        let (client, _) = fake_api_status(|path| {
            if path == "/api/v1/tasks" {
                (
                    500,
                    json!({ "code": "internal", "message": "tasks unavailable" }),
                )
            } else {
                (
                    200,
                    json!({
                        "id": "id-1",
                        "name": "n1",
                        "revision": 7,
                        "spec": { "address": "10.0.0.1:7443", "maintenance": true, "witness": false },
                        "status": { "online": true }
                    }),
                )
            }
        })
        .await;
        let mut out = Vec::new();
        let mut err = Vec::new();

    /// 읽은 뒤 노드가 바뀌어 PUT이 `revision_mismatch`면 다시 읽어 쓴다.
    #[tokio::test]
    async fn node_maintenance_retries_a_revision_mismatch() {
        let calls = std::sync::atomic::AtomicUsize::new(0);
        let (client, seen) = fake_api_status(move |_| {
            // GET, PUT(409), GET, PUT 차례다.
            match calls.fetch_add(1, std::sync::atomic::Ordering::SeqCst) {
                1 => (
                    409,
                    json!({ "code": "revision_mismatch", "message": "node n1 changed" }),
                ),
                _ => (
                    200,
                    json!({
                        "id": "id-1",
                        "name": "n1",
                        "revision": 7,
                        "spec": { "address": "10.0.0.1:7443", "maintenance": false, "witness": false },
                        "status": { "online": true }
                    }),
                ),
            }
        })
        .await;
        let mut out = Vec::new();
        node_maintenance(&client, "n1", true, &mut out, &mut Vec::new())
            .await
            .unwrap();
        assert_eq!(String::from_utf8(out).unwrap(), "node n1: maintenance on\n");
        assert_eq!(
            *seen.lock().unwrap(),
            [
                "GET /api/v1/nodes/n1 HTTP/1.1",
                "PUT /api/v1/nodes/n1 HTTP/1.1",
                "GET /api/v1/nodes/n1 HTTP/1.1",
                "PUT /api/v1/nodes/n1 HTTP/1.1",
            ]
        );
    }

    /// `node drain`은 비우기 Task를 만들고 따라가는 방법을 알린다. `--wait`이면 Task를 기다리고, Task가
    /// 실패하면(옮기지 못한 VM) 그 오류로 끝난다.
    #[tokio::test]
    async fn node_drain_starts_the_task() {
        let (client, seen) = fake_api(|path| match path {
            "/api/v1/nodes/n1/drain" => json!({ "id": "t1" }),
            "/api/v1/nodes/n2/drain" => json!({ "id": "t2" }),
            "/api/v1/tasks/t2" => json!({ "id": "t2", "status": {
                "state": "failed",
                "error": "1 VM(s) were not moved: db (disks on a local pool)"
            } }),
            _ => json!({ "id": "t1", "status": { "state": "succeeded" } }),
        })
        .await;
        let run = |args: &'static [&'static str]| {
            let client = client.clone();
            async move {
                let Cmd::Node {
                    cmd: NodeCmd::Drain { node, wait },
                } = Cli::try_parse_from(args).unwrap().cmd
                else {
                    unreachable!()
                };
                let mut out = Vec::new();
                node_drain(&client, &node, wait, &mut out)
                    .await
                    .map(|()| String::from_utf8(out).unwrap())
            }
        };

        assert_eq!(
            run(&["oplctl", "node", "drain", "n1"]).await.unwrap(),
            "drain of n1 started (task t1); follow it with `orbivisorctl task get t1`\n"
        );
        assert_eq!(
            *seen.lock().unwrap(),
            ["POST /api/v1/nodes/n1/drain HTTP/1.1"]
        );
        seen.lock().unwrap().clear();
        assert_eq!(
            run(&["oplctl", "node", "drain", "n1", "--wait"])
                .await
                .unwrap(),
            "node n1 drained\n"
        );
        assert_eq!(
            *seen.lock().unwrap(),
            [
                "POST /api/v1/nodes/n1/drain HTTP/1.1",
                "GET /api/v1/tasks/t1 HTTP/1.1"
            ]
        );
        let err = run(&["oplctl", "node", "drain", "n2", "--wait"])
            .await
            .unwrap_err();
        assert_eq!(
            err.to_string(),
            "task t2 failed: 1 VM(s) were not moved: db (disks on a local pool)"
        );
    }

    /// `placement set`은 준 값만 `placement`에 담고, 아무것도 없으면 오류다.
    #[test]
    fn placement_set_body_sends_only_given_values() {
        let parse = |args: &[&str]| -> PlacementSet {
            let mut argv = vec!["oplctl", "placement", "set"];
            argv.extend(args);
            match Cli::try_parse_from(argv).unwrap().cmd {
                Cmd::Placement {
                    cmd: PlacementCmd::Set(s),
                } => s,
                _ => panic!("not placement set"),
            }
        };
        assert_eq!(
            placement_set_body(&parse(&["--mode", "auto"])).unwrap(),
            json!({ "placement": { "mode": "auto" } })
        );
        assert_eq!(
            placement_set_body(&parse(&[
                "--mode",
                "off",
                "--policy",
                "pack",
                "--threshold",
                "20"
            ]))
            .unwrap(),
            json!({ "placement": { "mode": "off", "policy": "pack", "threshold": 20 } })
        );
        let err = placement_set_body(&parse(&[])).unwrap_err();
        assert_eq!(err.to_string(), "give --mode, --policy or --threshold");
        for bad in [
            &["--mode", "manual"][..],
            &["--policy", "spread"],
            &["--threshold", "x"],
        ] {
            let mut argv = vec!["oplctl", "placement", "set"];
            argv.extend(bad);
            assert!(Cli::try_parse_from(argv).is_err(), "{bad:?}");
        }
        assert!(Cli::try_parse_from(["oplctl", "placement", "status"]).is_ok());
    }

    /// `placement status`의 머리 줄(빠진 설정은 기본값)과 노드 행(요약이 없으면 `-`)
    #[test]
    fn placement_status_lines_and_rows() {
        let status = json!({
            "leader": "00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001",
            "settings": {},
            "nodes": [],
            "recommendations": []
        });
        assert_eq!(
            placement_status_lines(&status),
            [
                "mode: recommend  policy: balance  threshold: 15%",
                "imbalance: -",
                "last run: -  next run: -"
            ]
        );
        let status = json!({
            "settings": { "mode": "auto", "policy": "pack", "threshold": 20 },
            "imbalance": { "cpu_pct": 182, "mem_pct": 238, "total_pct": 210 },
            "last_run": 1_793_000_000,
            "next_run": 1_793_000_300,
            "paused": "a node is in maintenance",
        });
        assert_eq!(
            placement_status_lines(&status),
            [
                "mode: auto  policy: pack  threshold: 20%",
                "imbalance: 21.0% (cpu 18.2%, memory 23.8%)",
                "last run: 2026-10-26 07:33 UTC  next run: 2026-10-26 07:38 UTC",
                "paused: a node is in maintenance"
            ]
        );
        let fresh = json!({
            "node": "00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001", "name": "n1",
            "cpu1_pct": 905, "cpu5_pct": 850, "mem_used_mib": 4096,
            "mem_allocated_mib": 2048, "mem_total_mib": 8192,
            "cpu_use_pct": 850, "mem_use_pct": 500, "vms": 2, "age_secs": 3
        });
        assert_eq!(
            placement_node_row(&fresh),
            [
                "n1", "90.5%", "85.0%", "4.0GiB", "2.0GiB", "8.0GiB", "85.0%", "50.0%", "2", "3s"
            ]
        );
        let unknown = json!({
            "node": "00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000002", "name": "n2",
            "mem_allocated_mib": 0, "mem_total_mib": 8192,
            "cpu_use_pct": 850, "mem_use_pct": 0, "vms": 0
        });
        assert_eq!(
            placement_node_row(&unknown),
            [
                "n2", "-", "-", "-", "0B", "8.0GiB", "85.0%", "0.0%", "0", "-"
            ]
        );
    }

    /// `placement recommendations`의 행(id 끝 12자, 효과 0.1% 단위, 비용 MiB)
    #[test]
    fn recommendation_rows() {
        let r = json!({
            "id": "01a1d94a-4077-71cf-87cd-b31828a18c08",
            "vm": "01a1d949-c903-733a-9e5c-879b16c48048", "vm_name": "web",
            "from": "01a1d949-c559-72a7-ad90-8a2021b63e4a", "from_name": "n1",
            "to": "01a1d949-c574-70e0-9bc5-813969017b7e", "to_name": "n2",

        });

                "b31828a18c08",

                "n1",

    /// `placement apply`는 id 전체·앞부분·끝부분(표의 ID)으로 추천을 찾는다(대소문자 무시). 없거나 여럿이면 오류다.
    /// 한 회차의 추천은 UUIDv7이라 앞부분이 같다.
    #[test]
    fn find_recommendation_by_prefix_or_suffix() {
        let list = [
            json!({ "id": "01a1d94a-4077-71cf-87cd-b31828a18c08", "vm_name": "web" }),
            json!({ "id": "01a1d94a-4077-72cf-91aa-0123456789ab", "vm_name": "db" }),
        ];
        let id =
            |key: &str| recommendation_row(find_recommendation(&list, key).unwrap())[0].clone();
        assert_eq!(id("B31828A18C08"), "b31828a18c08");
        assert_eq!(id("0123456789ab"), "0123456789ab");
        assert_eq!(id("01a1d94a-4077-71"), "b31828a18c08");
        assert_eq!(
            find_recommendation(&list, "01a1d94a-4077-72cf-91aa-0123456789ab").unwrap()["vm_name"],
            "db"
        );
        assert_eq!(
            find_recommendation(&list, "01a1d94a")
                .unwrap_err()
                .to_string(),
            "2 recommendations match 01a1d94a; give more of the id"
        );
        assert_eq!(
            find_recommendation(&list, "ff").unwrap_err().to_string(),
            "no recommendation ff; recommendations are recomputed every run (see `placement recommendations`)"
        );
        assert_eq!(
            find_recommendation(&list, "").unwrap_err().to_string(),
            "give the recommendation id"
        );
    }

    fn vm_set(args: &[&str]) -> VmSet {
        let mut argv = vec!["oplctl", "vm", "set", "web"];
        argv.extend(args);
        match Cli::try_parse_from(argv).unwrap().cmd {
            Cmd::Vm { cmd: VmCmd::Set(s) } => s,
            _ => panic!("not vm set"),
        }
    }

    /// `vm set`의 CPU·메모리 플래그는 준 값만 바꾸고, `--no-max-*`는 상한 필드를 뺀다.
    #[test]
    fn vm_set_changes_only_the_given_cpu_and_memory_values() {
        let vm = json!({
            "name": "web",
            "spec": {
                "cpu": { "sockets": 1, "cores": 2, "model": "host", "max_vcpus": 8 },
                "memory_mib": 4096,
                "max_memory_mib": 16384,
                "ha": false,
            },
        });
        assert_eq!(
            vm_set_spec(&vm, &vm_set(&["--cores", "4"]))["spec"],
            json!({
                "cpu": { "sockets": 1, "cores": 4, "model": "host", "max_vcpus": 8 },
                "memory_mib": 4096,
                "max_memory_mib": 16384,
                "ha": false,
            })
        );
        assert_eq!(
            vm_set_spec(
                &vm,
                &vm_set(&["--sockets", "2", "--memory", "8192", "--max-vcpus", "16"])
            )["spec"],
            json!({
                "cpu": { "sockets": 2, "cores": 2, "model": "host", "max_vcpus": 16 },
                "memory_mib": 8192,
                "max_memory_mib": 16384,
                "ha": false,
            })
        );
        assert_eq!(
            vm_set_spec(&vm, &vm_set(&["--no-max-vcpus", "--no-max-memory"]))["spec"],
            json!({
                "cpu": { "sockets": 1, "cores": 2, "model": "host" },
                "memory_mib": 4096,
                "ha": false,
            })
        );
        assert_eq!(
            vm_set_spec(&vm, &vm_set(&["--max-memory", "32768"]))["spec"]["max_memory_mib"],
            32768
        );
        assert!(vm_set(&["--cores", "4"]).changes_hardware());
        assert!(vm_set(&["--no-max-memory"]).changes_hardware());
        assert!(!vm_set(&["--pinned"]).changes_hardware());
        assert!(vm_set(&["--memory", "1024", "--no-wait"]).no_wait);
        for bad in [
            &["--max-vcpus", "4", "--no-max-vcpus"][..],
            &["--max-memory", "4096", "--no-max-memory"],
            // 바꿀 것 없이 `--no-wait`만 줄 수 없다.
            &["--no-wait"],
        ] {
            let mut argv = vec!["oplctl", "vm", "set", "web"];
            argv.extend(bad);
            assert!(Cli::try_parse_from(argv).is_err(), "{bad:?}");
        }
        let Cmd::Vm {
            cmd: VmCmd::Create(c),
        } = Cli::try_parse_from([
            "oplctl",
            "vm",
            "create",
            "web",
            "--max-vcpus",
            "8",
            "--max-memory",
            "16384",
        ])
        .unwrap()
        .cmd
        else {
            panic!("not vm create");
        };
        assert_eq!((c.max_vcpus, c.max_memory), (Some(8), Some(16384)));
    }

    /// `vm disk add|remove`는 디스크 목록 끝에 붙이거나 그 볼륨의 디스크를 뺀다. 없는 볼륨은 오류다.
    #[test]
    fn disk_commands_append_and_remove_disks() {
        let vm = json!({
            "name": "web",
            "labels": { "team": "a" },
            "spec": {
                "disks": [
                    { "volume": "root", "bus": "virtio-blk", "boot_order": 1 },
                    { "volume": "data", "bus": "virtio-blk", "boot_order": null },
                ],
            },
        });
        assert_eq!(
            disk_add_spec(&vm, "logs", DiskBus::VirtioBlk, None),
            json!({
                "labels": { "team": "a" },
                "spec": { "disks": [
                    { "volume": "root", "bus": "virtio-blk", "boot_order": 1 },
                    { "volume": "data", "bus": "virtio-blk", "boot_order": null },
                    { "volume": "logs", "bus": "virtio-blk", "boot_order": null },
                ] },
            })
        );
        assert_eq!(
            disk_add_spec(&vm, "cd", DiskBus::Sata, Some(2))["spec"]["disks"][2],
            json!({ "volume": "cd", "bus": "sata", "boot_order": 2 })
        );
        assert_eq!(
            disk_remove_spec(&vm, "root").unwrap()["spec"]["disks"],
            json!([{ "volume": "data", "bus": "virtio-blk", "boot_order": null }])
        );
        assert_eq!(
            disk_remove_spec(&vm, "logs").unwrap_err().to_string(),
            "VM web has no disk on volume logs"
        );
        let cli = Cli::try_parse_from([
            "oplctl",
            "vm",
            "disk",
            "add",
            "web",
            "data",
            "--bus",
            "sata",
            "--boot-order",
            "2",
            "--no-wait",
        ])
        .unwrap();
        assert!(matches!(
            cli.cmd,
            Cmd::Vm { cmd: VmCmd::Disk { cmd: VmDiskCmd::Add {
                vm, volume, bus: DiskBus::Sata, boot_order: Some(2), no_wait: true
            } } } if vm == "web" && volume == "data"
        ));
        let cli = Cli::try_parse_from(["oplctl", "vm", "disk", "remove", "web", "data"]).unwrap();
        assert!(matches!(
            cli.cmd,
            Cmd::Vm {
                cmd: VmCmd::Disk {
                    cmd: VmDiskCmd::Remove { no_wait: false, .. }
                }
            }
        ));
        let cli = Cli::try_parse_from(["oplctl", "vm", "hotplug", "web"]).unwrap();
        assert!(matches!(
            cli.cmd,
            Cmd::Vm { cmd: VmCmd::Hotplug { vm, no_wait: false } } if vm == "web"
        ));
    }

    /// `vm nic add`는 `--nic`과 같은 `NETWORK[,sg=…]`로 끝에 붙이고, `vm nic remove`는 번호나 MAC(대소문자
    /// 무시)으로 찾아 뺀다.
    #[test]
    fn nic_commands_append_and_remove_nics() {
        let vm = json!({
            "name": "web",
            "spec": {
                "nics": [
                    { "network": "lan", "model": "virtio", "mac": "52:54:00:aa:bb:01" },
                    { "network": "dmz", "model": "e1000e", "mac": "52:54:00:aa:bb:02" },
                ],
            },
        });
        let nic = parse_nic("lan,sg=web+db").unwrap();
        assert_eq!(
            nic_add_spec(&vm, &nic, NicModel::E1000e, Some("52:54:00:aa:bb:03"))["spec"]["nics"][2],
            json!({
                "network": "lan", "model": "e1000e", "mac": "52:54:00:aa:bb:03",
                "security_groups": ["web", "db"],
            })
        );
        assert_eq!(
            nic_add_spec(&vm, &parse_nic("user").unwrap(), NicModel::Virtio, None)["spec"]["nics"]
                [2],
            json!({ "network": "user", "model": "virtio" })
        );
        let dmz = json!([{ "network": "dmz", "model": "e1000e", "mac": "52:54:00:aa:bb:02" }]);
        assert_eq!(nic_remove_spec(&vm, "0").unwrap()["spec"]["nics"], dmz);
        assert_eq!(
            nic_remove_spec(&vm, "52:54:00:AA:BB:01").unwrap()["spec"]["nics"],
            dmz
        );
        assert_eq!(
            nic_remove_spec(&vm, "2").unwrap_err().to_string(),
            "VM web has no NIC 2 (2 NICs, numbered from 0)"
        );
        assert_eq!(
            nic_remove_spec(&vm, "52:54:00:aa:bb:09")
                .unwrap_err()
                .to_string(),
            "VM web has no NIC with MAC 52:54:00:aa:bb:09"
        );
        let cli = Cli::try_parse_from([
            "oplctl",
            "vm",
            "nic",
            "add",
            "web",
            "lan,sg=web",
            "--model",
            "e1000e",
        ])
        .unwrap();
        assert!(matches!(
            cli.cmd,
            Cmd::Vm { cmd: VmCmd::Nic { cmd: VmNicCmd::Add {
                nic, model: NicModel::E1000e, mac: None, no_wait: false, ..
            } } } if nic.network == "lan" && nic.security_groups == ["web"]
        ));
        assert!(Cli::try_parse_from(["oplctl", "vm", "nic", "add", "web", "lan,x"]).is_err());
    }

    /// `vm get`의 하드웨어 줄: 배치가 있으면 vCPU·메모리·포트, 없으면 핫플러그 없이 켰다는 줄, 꺼지면 없음.
    #[test]
    fn hardware_line_shows_the_running_layout() {
        let vm = json!({ "status": { "hardware": {
            "cpu": { "sockets": 1, "cores": 2, "model": "host", "max_vcpus": 8 },
            "memory_mib": 4096,
            "layout": {
                "vcpus": 4, "max_memory_mib": 16384, "plugged_mib": 2048, "ports": 8,
                "boot_disks": 1, "boot_nics": 1, "disk_ports": [0], "nic_ports": [1],
            },
        } } });
        assert_eq!(
            hardware_line(&vm).unwrap(),
            "hardware: vcpus 4/8, memory 6144/16384 MiB, hotplug ports 2/8 used"
        );
        // 상한이 없으면 켤 때 수다.
        let vm = json!({ "status": { "hardware": {
            "cpu": { "sockets": 2, "cores": 2, "model": "host" },
            "memory_mib": 1024,
            "layout": {
                "vcpus": 4, "max_memory_mib": 1024, "plugged_mib": 0, "ports": 8,
                "boot_disks": 1, "boot_nics": 0,
            },
        } } });
        assert_eq!(
            hardware_line(&vm).unwrap(),
            "hardware: vcpus 4/4, memory 1024/1024 MiB, hotplug ports 0/8 used"
        );
        let legacy = json!({ "status": { "hardware": {
            "cpu": { "sockets": 1, "cores": 2, "model": "host" }, "memory_mib": 1024,
        } } });
        assert_eq!(
            hardware_line(&legacy).unwrap(),
            "hardware: no hotplug (started without it)"
        );
        assert_eq!(hardware_line(&json!({ "status": {} })), None);
    }

    /// 보류 줄은 항목·지금 값 → 바랄 값·이유(있으면 자세한 설명)다.
    #[test]
    fn pending_lines_show_the_reason_and_detail() {
        let vm = json!({ "status": { "hardware": { "pending": [
            { "field": "memory_mib", "running": "4096", "wanted": "8192", "reason": "unsupported",
              "detail": "this node has no virtio-mem" },
            { "field": "firmware", "running": "uefi", "wanted": "bios", "reason": "restart" },
            { "field": "vcpus", "running": "4", "wanted": "2", "reason": "failed",
              "detail": "the guest did not release vCPU 3 within 60s" },
        ] } } });
        assert_eq!(
            pending_lines(&vm),
            [
                "  memory_mib: 4096 -> 8192 (unsupported: this node has no virtio-mem)",
                "  firmware: uefi -> bios (restart)",
                "  vcpus: 4 -> 2 (failed: the guest did not release vCPU 3 within 60s)",
            ]
        );
        assert!(pending_lines(&json!({ "status": { "hardware": {} } })).is_empty());
        assert!(pending_lines(&json!({ "status": {} })).is_empty());
    }

    /// PUT 응답에 `orbivisor-task`가 없으면(꺼진 VM 등) Task를 기다리지 않는다. 있으면 기다린 뒤 VM을 다시 읽어
    /// 바로 적용됐는지나 보류를 알린다.
    #[tokio::test]
    async fn hardware_changes_wait_only_for_a_hotplug_task() {
        let (client, seen) = fake_api(|_| {
            json!({ "id": "v1", "name": "web", "revision": 3, "spec": {
                "cpu": { "sockets": 1, "cores": 1 }, "memory_mib": 256, "disks": [],
            } })
        })
        .await;
        let task = put_spec(&client, "web", |current| {
            Ok(disk_add_spec(current, "data", DiskBus::VirtioBlk, None))
        })
        .await
        .unwrap();
        assert_eq!(task, None);
        let mut out = Vec::new();
        hotplug_result(
            &client,
            "web",
            task,
            false,
            "vm web: disk data added",
            &mut out,
        )
        .await
        .unwrap();
        assert_eq!(
            *seen.lock().unwrap(),
            [
                "GET /api/v1/vms/web HTTP/1.1",
                "PUT /api/v1/vms/web HTTP/1.1"
            ]
        );
        assert_eq!(String::from_utf8(out).unwrap(), "vm web: disk data added\n");

        let (client, seen) = fake_api(|path| {
            if path.starts_with("/api/v1/tasks/") {
                json!({ "id": "t1", "status": { "state": "succeeded" } })
            } else {
                json!({ "name": "web", "status": { "hardware": { "pending": [
                    { "field": "memory_mib", "running": "256", "wanted": "512", "reason": "limit" },
                ] } } })
            }
        })
        .await;
        let mut out = Vec::new();
        hotplug_result(
            &client,
            "web",
            Some("t1".into()),
            false,
            "vm web: hardware updated",
            &mut out,
        )
        .await
        .unwrap();
        assert_eq!(
            *seen.lock().unwrap(),
            [
                "GET /api/v1/tasks/t1 HTTP/1.1",
                "GET /api/v1/vms/web HTTP/1.1"
            ]
        );
        assert_eq!(
            String::from_utf8(out).unwrap(),
            "vm web: hardware updated\nvm web: pending until restart:\n  memory_mib: 256 -> 512 (limit)\n"
        );
        // `--no-wait`는 Task id만 알린다.
        let mut out = Vec::new();
        hotplug_result(
            &client,
            "web",
            Some("t2".into()),
            true,
            "vm web: hardware updated",
            &mut out,
        )
        .await
        .unwrap();
        assert_eq!(
            String::from_utf8(out).unwrap(),
            "vm web: hardware updated\nvm web: hotplug task t2 started\n"
        );
    }

    /// 핫플러그 Task가 실패하면 그 이유로 실패하고 바뀐 것을 알리지 않는다.
    #[tokio::test]
    async fn a_failed_hotplug_task_fails_the_command() {
        let (client, _) = fake_api(|_| {
            json!({ "id": "t1", "status": { "state": "failed",
                "error": "disk \"data\" was not added: no space; the change was undone" } })
        })
        .await;
        let mut out = Vec::new();
        let err = hotplug_result(
            &client,
            "web",
            Some("t1".into()),
            false,
            "vm web: disk data added",
            &mut out,
        )
        .await
        .unwrap_err();
        assert_eq!(
            err.to_string(),
            "task t1 failed: disk \"data\" was not added: no space; the change was undone"
        );
